name: Sherrod Brown [DOTL]
subject: I’m just a guy
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Democracy on the Line PAC
body:
I'm just a guy driving a union-made Jeep and fighting for the Dignity of Work

|
---
Team – my Trump-backed opponent, Bernie Moreno, has shown who he is time and again, so we should believe him.

He's the guy who stole his employees' overtime wages and then shredded the evidence.

He's the guy who used a taxpayer-funded police escort for a joyride on closed public roads in his $3.4 million sports car.

He's the guy who's gone on the record to say he's "100% pro-life with no exceptions" and would vote against the will of Ohio voters for a national abortion ban in the Senate.

I hope you already know this, but in case you don't, I want to be clear: I'm the guy that drives a union-made Jeep, fights for the Dignity of Work, and has always supported reproductive freedom.

But I'm worried. Polls show this race is statistically tied, and Republicans are spending record amounts to defeat me because they know Ohio will decide Senate control. Now, I'm counting on a massive surge in grassroots support to right the ship before it's too late.

Whenever we talk about the Electoral College, Friend, we get a bunch of replies complaining that, if we dropped the Electoral College, the candidates would only go a handful of big states. Well, check out this map the Associated Press put together . It's the cities that have seen campaign stops from the 2024 presidential candidates:
AP map of 2024 presidential campaign stops [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/EA/EA007/1/89215/images/AP_CampaignMap2024.png]
Not a great look, is it? Eight or so states with more than two stops, a handful more with one or two, and more than half the states with zero . And those big states? Already on this list, with California, Texas, Florida, and New York all having multiple stops.
This map is further evidence that this dated system -- one that is supposed to bring fairness to the process of electing our national executive -- is broken, driving the candidates into a handful of states while more than half the country likely won't see a presidential candidate ever.
Every day, more pro-democracy activists join our movement. Will you chip in $35 or whatever you can today and help us ditch the Electoral College? >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-end-electoral-college?refcode=090924_3&amount=35]

We have an answer and an alternative to the Electoral College that will work without a constitutional amendment: The National Popular Vote Interstate Compact.

subject: Following in Ruby Bridges’ footsteps

body:
Their “firsts” paved the way for me, and for so many others.
| [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/92497198/497319184/-3547583?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjBmNDkzZWI1LTA5NmYtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=ndToqu_5yCdjK38GuKtCEXFN4fqDN-kT0XjXKXXI7K0=&emci=c5113b24-d76e-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&emdi=0f493eb5-096f-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&ceid=8431045)
---

Peter, It might be easy to assume that stories of school integration are ancient history. But this week, as Ruby Bridges — who made history by integrating her elementary school in New Orleans — turns 70 years old, we must reckon with the fact that the trauma that our heroes endured during the Civil Rights Movement occurred just decades ago. In the years that followed the iconic image of federal marshals escorting Ruby Bridges to kindergarten, many Black Americans would follow in her footsteps. That included the woman who would later become my sister-in-law: Vivian Malone Jones. My brave, brilliant, and barrier-breaking sister-in-law was one of the first two Black students who integrated and enrolled at the University of Alabama. | [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/92497199/497319185/-1279676690?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_RubyBridges_email_20240909-NDRC-Tier1-RubyBridges_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20240909-NDRC-Tier1-RubyBridges_&utm_campaign=RubyBridges&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjBmNDkzZWI1LTA5NmYtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=ndToqu_5yCdjK38GuKtCEXFN4fqDN-kT0XjXKXXI7K0=)
---
When Vivian arrived at the University of Alabama, she was met by Governor George Wallace who was determined not to allow her to attend her state’s university — simply because she was Black.
It was only after President Kennedy called out the National Guard to escort her onto campus that she was permitted to begin her enrollment process.
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/92497200/497319186/-1279676690?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_RubyBridges_email_20240909-NDRC-Tier1-RubyBridges_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20240909-NDRC-Tier1-RubyBridges_&utm_campaign=RubyBridges&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjBmNDkzZWI1LTA5NmYtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=ndToqu_5yCdjK38GuKtCEXFN4fqDN-kT0XjXKXXI7K0=)
---
It’s hard to imagine what Vivian endured as she dreamt of and pursued her college education — a few months after she arrived on campus, racists set off bombs mere blocks from her dorm.
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/92497201/497319187/-1279676690?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_RubyBridges_email_20240909-NDRC-Tier1-RubyBridges_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20240909-NDRC-Tier1-RubyBridges_&utm_campaign=RubyBridges&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjBmNDkzZWI1LTA5NmYtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=ndToqu_5yCdjK38GuKtCEXFN4fqDN-kT0XjXKXXI7K0=)
---
But Vivian never wavered. She would go on to make further history and become the first Black student to graduate from the university.
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/92497202/497319188/-1279676690?refcode=don_ndrc_tier1_email_RubyBridges_email_20240909-NDRC-Tier1-RubyBridges_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20240909-NDRC-Tier1-RubyBridges_&utm_campaign=RubyBridges&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjBmNDkzZWI1LTA5NmYtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=ndToqu_5yCdjK38GuKtCEXFN4fqDN-kT0XjXKXXI7K0=)
---
**Today — and always — I’m thinking a lot about Ruby Bridges, Vivian Malone Jones, and the sheer courage and tenacity it must have taken for them to persist amidst so much hatred. **
Their “firsts” paved the way for me, and for so many others.
Thank you to these trailblazers for lighting the path for all of us.
Eric H. Holder, Jr.,
82nd Attorney General of the United States

clean_body: Their “firsts” paved the way for me, and for so many others. | Peter, It might be easy to assume that stories of school integration are ancient history. But this week, as Ruby Bridges — who made history by integrating her elementary school in New Orleans — turns 70 years old, we must reckon with the fact that the trauma that our heroes endured during the Civil Rights Movement occurred just decades ago. In the years that followed the iconic image of federal marshals escorting Ruby Bridges to kindergarten, many Black Americans would follow in her footsteps. That included the woman who would later become my sister-in-law: Vivian Malone Jones. My brave, brilliant, and barrier-breaking sister-in-law was one of the first two Black students who integrated and enrolled at the University of Alabama. | = When Vivian arrived at the University of Alabama, she was met by Governor George Wallace who was determined not to allow her to attend her state’s university — simply because she was Black. It was only after President Kennedy called out the National Guard to escort her onto campus that she was permitted to begin her enrollment process. = It’s hard to imagine what Vivian endured as she dreamt of and pursued her college education — a few months after she arrived on campus, racists set off bombs mere blocks from her dorm. = But Vivian never wavered. She would go on to make further history and become the first Black student to graduate from the university. = Today — and always — I’m thinking a lot about Ruby Bridges, Vivian Malone Jones, and the sheer courage and tenacity it must have taken for them to persist amidst so much hatred. Their “firsts” paved the way for me, and for so many others. Thank you to these trailblazers for lighting the path for all of us. Eric H. **Contact:**[press@davemin.com](mailto:press@davemin.com)
**ICYMI: Los Angeles Times Endorses Dave Min**
**LOS ANGELES, CA —** Today, the Los Angeles Times announced their endorsement of Dave Min for Congress, citing his long history of public service, his tenacious advocacy for reproductive freedom and the environment, and his strong character.

>From the Editorial Board: **"** By far the better candidate to represent the interests of the district is Min, who, like Porter, is a former law professor at UC Irvine. He would fight to protect abortion, IVF and contraception rights; he wants to bolster public education at all levels; and he carried state legislation to [phase out oil and gas drilling](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=d8dcb35c34&e=7017cc100e) in California waters, which didn’t pass but was the right idea."
[Read The Full Article Here](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=38e839324f&e=7017cc100e)

### _California’s 47th is an open[DCCC Red To Blue](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=7edbc6ec03&e=7017cc100e) Congressional District in Orange County that includes the Cities of Costa Mesa, Huntington Beach, Irvine, Newport Beach, and Seal Beach, and portions of Laguna Beach, Laguna Hills, and Laguna Woods. Incumbent Democratic Representative Katie Porter is not running for re-election. In 2022, Porter defeated former Assemblymember Republican Scott Baugh by 3.44% in this [“toss up”](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=562d28feb3&e=7017cc100e) district. State Senator Dave Min currently represents over 80% of Congressional District 47 in Sacramento. In 2020, Min received over 158,000 votes within CA-47, defeating incumbent John Moorlach by 5.15% in this area. 19% of the registered voters in CA-47 are of Asian and Pacific Islander descent, including one of the largest Korean-American populations in the country._****

# FROM THE DESK OF LARRY KUDLOW
---
| | Reader,**I am pleased to share with you that The New York Sun, one of my daily must-read papers, is now the exclusive publisher of my regular columns.

I invite you to consider joining the Sun to receive unlimited access to my latest commentary, alongside some of the finest American journalism.

**But there's also far more to what the Sun is building.

As you know, journalism isn't what it used to be.

I've been in the business for decades, and never before have I seen this once noble profession so abused. The major papers are no longer on the side of the American people, and we are right to withhold our trust.

The impact on our democracy is considerable. Without real accountability, the worst actors in government and at corporate institutions have free reign, and patriotic, hard-working Americans are being sidelined and ignored.

The antidote is to join the movement to build a better alternative. That's the American way.

**The charge to restore American journalism is being led by the Sun.** A proudly all-American, principled publication that has plenty of room for conservative thought and conservative writers, the Sun has upheld the highest journalistic standards since 1833. That's 18 years before the New York Times published its first number.**My decision for the New York Sun to become the exclusive publisher of my regular columns was not taken lightly.**

I value their work and have been impressed by their team, but I know they have a hell of a battle ahead. They are the David facing many Goliaths.

They will only succeed if we join with them in this grassroots national effort. Joining the Sun costs as little as a penny a day. I encourage you to sign up today. Every single person counts.

body:
Here is the truth
---
Derek -- In just a moment, we are going to ask you to [**donate directly to the Democratic National Committee**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-september-elect-dems-2024?amount=3&refcode=em_20240909_1245_fr&refcode2=1290_22930333_jTH3Ab&akid=1290%2E22930333%2EjTH3Ab) before tomorrow night's debate begins and our FEC deadline ends. Please give us a chance to explain why this request is so important. Here is the truth: This is a moment in the race where three critical, but unique, moments collide. And all of them require our attention and your financial support. First, we will need the resources to be able to respond to anything that happens in the debate tomorrow night. We know Republicans will be ready, and we need to be as well. Second, as you read this, the first ballots of the election are dropping in mailboxes across several states. People are voting! And we are running out of time to reach them before they do. Finally, during the homestretch of presidential years, our official FEC deadlines happen every month. That means shortly after this debate we'll have another one right around the corner. And this one is especially important. It will be the last one before much of the country is eligible to vote. So we're hoping for a big report. And at the same time, we also need to reach our very real fundraising goals for the month. And we need you for both. You may not have woken up thinking today was the day you'd donate to the DNC, but we hope this explanation helped. | | Friend, Back when you were growing up, you may remember lazy Saturdays at the library with a kind but stern librarian. She would fill your mind with classics like _Pat the Bunny_ and _The Little Engine That Could_. And eventually you got old enough to roam by yourself and discover adventures like the _Three Musketeers_ , _Treasure Island_ and _Charlotte’s Web_. But today, all that has changed. The president of the American Library Association (ALA) is a self-described “Marxist lesbian.” Radical librarians call _Adventure of Huckleberry Finn_ and _To Kill a Mockingbird_ “racist.” They’ve stripped Laura Ingalls Wilder’s name from a prestigious book award because of her “problematic” _Little House_ series. And they bring men in wearing full makeup, dresses, and high heels for “Drag Queen Story Hours” where books like these are read to children of all ages... A is for Activist. An ABC board book for “families who want their kids to grow up in a space that is unapologetic about activism, environmental justice, civil rights, LGBTQ rights, and everything else that activists believe in and fight for...”

| | For decades, the ultra-liberal Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation and George Soros’ Open Society have spent millions radicalizing the ALA. And as a result, a new generation of pink-haired, activist librarians have made it their mission to fill library shelves with anti-American, LGBTQ-friendly, and explicitly sexual content. Maybe you’ve noticed all the displays at your own library celebrating Pride Month or elevating “the environment” to a type of religion. The “Teen Zone” is filled with books like: _Rick_ about a cross-dressing Grandpa, _Melissa_ filled with graphic nudity, and _Darkstalker_ featuring gory violence and domestic abuse. But here’s what’s really alarming. We can’t just sit back and say, “Well, I’ll just make sure my family doesn’t go to “Drag Queen Story Hour” and we won’t check out those inappropriate books.” That may be good for your family – for now. But meanwhile, the ALA uses our taxpayer-funded libraries to lure in millions of other children who grow up to be the very activists who are destroying our country and conservative values! **[**I hope you see why I need your help today to TAKE BACK OUR LIBRARIES.**](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8j0GPnCAUxz8N3jDwQJADh506btpJe7DNNj0ZBNyhldVFXTPfvmE66YWE3_vn_97PxGUK400jeUIA1-BWBIDYEwJ4_3XEtP-Ol2fcfaE_8bv4Fqs8hU8IYLst_n_00VL6aMKUqWwKp9noCC-8phIqxRgHUVw1G1gNfAQgzFTUSmeUo7UYKfeGKKGKoIEAJ4oSQitJaFlVzgoHRtRS1B4c4uS-pzTRp2ANXbfDpDTPsbRzLCZ93bZlvR_WImhXb_fkS_Pm3bzlBIJ2SObD42Ge_6wIWjZysHwAPDorMQdFsKot4IHZynIjibMqd7F232K_znuyHrEGd-cXBCKz6F3YI2LN-euDbD7l_5HoA1gTFxNe3xBr_vkR0Z-a5_506i-fuwv03fml__7jqcP5KZJ2yxGmKaxCIk5e78JZ70PD3wAAAP__kHiClg)** My name is Kirk Cameron. Maybe you recognize me from the 1980’s family sitcom “Growing Pains” or from my work in inspirational movies like “Fireproof” and “Left Behind.” I know firsthand how dangerous it is to be indoctrinated by leftist values. Pride almost took me down as a young actor in Hollywood. But the gospel saved me. I love being an actor, but what’s far more important is being a husband, dad, grandad, and a Christian. When I saw what book publishers and libraries were doing to indoctrinate children with anti-God, anti-family, anti-America messages, I knew I had a duty to take action. So together with a small Christian book publisher aptly named **Brave Books** , I wrote “As You Grow” to teach children how to grow in wisdom through the fruit of the spirit. And then we decided to go one step further and counter those awful “Drag Queen Story Hours” with a wholesome Story Hour of our own. Our idea was to read the classic books you and I grew up with plus new wholesome Brave Books that captivate children with lessons in bravery, honesty, kindness, and patriotism. And boy, the ALA and radical librarians didn’t like that one bit. >> Over 50 libraries rejected our request to host our Story Hour. >> The ALA helped local libraries scheme ways to keep us out including booking all the event rooms for themselves. >> Social media blew up with attacks: I was compared to a Nazi (that’s original), Brave Books was accused of trying to “confuse and demoralize children,” our supporters were described as “bored moms/busybodies who need something to feel good about,” and on and on. I can’t even print most things these radicals said because it’s so vile. In the end we got two libraries to reverse course by reminding them that their censorship violated the Constitution of the United States. And thousands of parents and grandparents brought their little ones to those Story Hours where we pledged allegiance to the flag, sang “God Bless America,” and read wholesome and Godly books. It was incredible. But here’s the greatest part... From there, parents and grandparents started asking Brave Books how they could host Story Hours of their own. So Brave Books has organized a nationwide grassroots “See You at the Library” movement to take back our libraries. Now with the guidance of Brave Books, committed conservatives just like you book event rooms at their local library for conservative Story Hours that fill children’s hearts with goodness, gratitude, and God. And whenever we can, Brave Books authors like swimmer Riley Gaines, TV personality Missy Robertson, and myself stand shoulder-to-shoulder with conservative parents, grandparents, and patriots at these Story Hours... ...for a very simple mission – to reject the Left’s radical ideas and reclaim childhood innocence in America’s libraries. And our ambitious goal is to expand our “See You at the Library” movement to reach over 100,000 children in the next year. Which is why we need you! __**[_I hope you’ll be able to give a sponsorship gift of $35, $50, $75, $100, $150 or more today._..](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8j0GPnCAUxz8N3jDwQJADh506btpJe7DNNj0ZBNyhldVFXTPfvmE66YWE3_vn_97PxGUK400jeUIA1-BWBIDYEwJ4_3XEtP-Ol2fcfaE_8bv4Fqs8hU8IYLst_n_00VL6aMKUqWwKp9noCC-8phIqxRgHUVw1G1gNfAQgzFTUSmeUo7UYKfeGKKGKoIEAJ4oSQitJaFlVzgoHRtRS1B4c4uS-pzTRp2ANXbfDpDTPsbRzLCZ93bZlvR_WImhXb_fkS_Pm3bzlBIJ2SObD42Ge_6wIWjZysHwAPDorMQdFsKot4IHZynIjibMqd7F232K_znuyHrEGd-cXBCKz6F3YI2LN-euDbD7l_5HoA1gTFxNe3xBr_vkR0Z-a5_506i-fuwv03fml__7jqcP5KZJ2yxGmKaxCIk5e78JZ70PD3wAAAP__kHiClg)** Your sponsorship gift will be used to send a “Story Hour Kit” to every parent, grandparent, and patriot who’s organizing an event at their library. The kit includes everything they need to bring your conservative values back into our public libraries: instructions for booking their library space and running their Story Hour, small American flags for the little ones, fun stickers, wholesome books, Bible memory verse cards, and other specialty items. Brave Books is a small Christian company. They don’t have the millions behind them like the giant taxpayer-funded ALA. Your sponsorship gift is the only way we can fund our Story Hours for over 100,000 children to counter the radical leftists who’ve taken control of our libraries. Knowing that, **_[_please consider a sponsorship gift of $175._](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8j0GPnCAUxz8N3jDwQJADh506btpJe7DNNj0ZBNyhldVFXTPfvmE66YWE3_vn_97PxGUK400jeUIA1-BWBIDYEwJ4_3XEtP-Ol2fcfaE_8bv4Fqs8hU8IYLst_n_00VL6aMKUqWwKp9noCC-8phIqxRgHUVw1G1gNfAQgzFTUSmeUo7UYKfeGKKGKoIEAJ4oSQitJaFlVzgoHRtRS1B4c4uS-pzTRp2ANXbfDpDTPsbRzLCZ93bZlvR_WImhXb_fkS_Pm3bzlBIJ2SObD42Ge_6wIWjZysHwAPDorMQdFsKot4IHZynIjibMqd7F232K_znuyHrEGd-cXBCKz6F3YI2LN-euDbD7l_5HoA1gTFxNe3xBr_vkR0Z-a5_506i-fuwv03fml__7jqcP5KZJ2yxGmKaxCIk5e78JZ70PD3wAAAP__kHiClg)_** That’s enough to sponsor one entire “Story Hour Kit” yourself. Singlehandedly, you’ll be reaching 50 children with our wholesome, Godly, and patriotic message. **_[Whatever you can give whether it’s $35, $175, or anything higher or lower will be necessary for the success of the next “Story Hour Kit” to be sent.](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8j0GPnCAUxz8N3jDwQJADh506btpJe7DNNj0ZBNyhldVFXTPfvmE66YWE3_vn_97PxGUK400jeUIA1-BWBIDYEwJ4_3XEtP-Ol2fcfaE_8bv4Fqs8hU8IYLst_n_00VL6aMKUqWwKp9noCC-8phIqxRgHUVw1G1gNfAQgzFTUSmeUo7UYKfeGKKGKoIEAJ4oSQitJaFlVzgoHRtRS1B4c4uS-pzTRp2ANXbfDpDTPsbRzLCZ93bZlvR_WImhXb_fkS_Pm3bzlBIJ2SObD42Ge_6wIWjZysHwAPDorMQdFsKot4IHZynIjibMqd7F232K_znuyHrEGd-cXBCKz6F3YI2LN-euDbD7l_5HoA1gTFxNe3xBr_vkR0Z-a5_506i-fuwv03fml__7jqcP5KZJ2yxGmKaxCIk5e78JZ70PD3wAAAP__kHiClg)_**

She would fill your mind with classics like Pat the Bunny and The Little Engine That Could. And eventually you got old enough to roam by yourself and discover adventures like the Three Musketeers , Treasure Island and Charlotte’s Web. But today, all that has changed. The president of the American Library Association (ALA) is a self-described “Marxist lesbian.” Radical librarians call Adventure of Huckleberry Finn and To Kill a Mockingbird “racist.” They’ve stripped Laura Ingalls Wilder’s name from a prestigious book award because of her “problematic” Little House series. And they bring men in wearing full makeup, dresses, and high heels for “Drag Queen Story Hours” where books like these are read to children of all ages... A is for Activist. A “family-friendly celebration of drag” that encourages children to “work it.” | | I wish I could tell you this was only happening in places like New York City and San Francisco. | | | But that’s just not true. <\- THIS IS A MAN leading “Drag Queen Story Hour.” | | But that’s just not true. THIS IS A MAN leading “Drag Queen Story Hour.” | | For decades, the ultra-liberal Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation and George Soros’ Open Society have spent millions radicalizing the ALA. And as a result, a new generation of pink-haired, activist librarians have made it their mission to fill library shelves with anti-American, LGBTQ-friendly, and explicitly sexual content. Maybe you’ve noticed all the displays at your own library celebrating Pride Month or elevating “the environment” to a type of religion. The “Teen Zone” is filled with books like: Rick about a cross-dressing Grandpa, Melissa filled with graphic nudity, and Darkstalker featuring gory violence and domestic abuse. But here’s what’s really alarming. We can’t just sit back and say, “Well, I’ll just make sure my family doesn’t go to “Drag Queen Story Hour” and we won’t check out those inappropriate books.” That may be good for your family – for now. But meanwhile, the ALA uses our taxpayer-funded libraries to lure in millions of other children who grow up to be the very activists who are destroying our country and conservative values! My name is Kirk Cameron. Maybe you recognize me from the 1980’s family sitcom “Growing Pains” or from my work in inspirational movies like “Fireproof” and “Left Behind.” I know firsthand how dangerous it is to be indoctrinated by leftist values. Pride almost took me down as a young actor in Hollywood. But the gospel saved me. I love being an actor, but what’s far more important is being a husband, dad, grandad, and a Christian. When I saw what book publishers and libraries were doing to indoctrinate children with anti-God, anti-family, anti-America messages, I knew I had a duty to take action. So together with a small Christian book publisher aptly named Brave Books , I wrote “As You Grow” to teach children how to grow in wisdom through the fruit of the spirit. And then we decided to go one step further and counter those awful “Drag Queen Story Hours” with a wholesome Story Hour of our own. Our idea was to read the classic books you and I grew up with plus new wholesome Brave Books that captivate children with lessons in bravery, honesty, kindness, and patriotism. And boy, the ALA and radical librarians didn’t like that one bit. >> Over 50 libraries rejected our request to host our Story Hour. >> The ALA helped local libraries scheme ways to keep us out including booking all the event rooms for themselves. >> Social media blew up with attacks: I was compared to a Nazi (that’s original), Brave Books was accused of trying to “confuse and demoralize children,” our supporters were described as “bored moms/busybodies who need something to feel good about,” and on and on. I can’t even print most things these radicals said because it’s so vile. In the end we got two libraries to reverse course by reminding them that their censorship violated the Constitution of the United States. And thousands of parents and grandparents brought their little ones to those Story Hours where we pledged allegiance to the flag, sang “God Bless America,” and read wholesome and Godly books. It was incredible. But here’s the greatest part... From there, parents and grandparents started asking Brave Books how they could host Story Hours of their own. So Brave Books has organized a nationwide grassroots “See You at the Library” movement to take back our libraries. Now with the guidance of Brave Books, committed conservatives just like you book event rooms at their local library for conservative Story Hours that fill children’s hearts with goodness, gratitude, and God. And whenever we can, Brave Books authors like swimmer Riley Gaines, TV personality Missy Robertson, and myself stand shoulder-to-shoulder with conservative parents, grandparents, and patriots at these Story Hours... ...for a very simple mission – to reject the Left’s radical ideas and reclaim childhood innocence in America’s libraries. And our ambitious goal is to expand our “See You at the Library” movement to reach over 100,000 children in the next year. Which is why we need you! Your sponsorship gift will be used to send a “Story Hour Kit” to every parent, grandparent, and patriot who’s organizing an event at their library. The kit includes everything they need to bring your conservative values back into our public libraries: instructions for booking their library space and running their Story Hour, small American flags for the little ones, fun stickers, wholesome books, Bible memory verse cards, and other specialty items. Brave Books is a small Christian company. They don’t have the millions behind them like the giant taxpayer-funded ALA. Your sponsorship gift is the only way we can fund our Story Hours for over 100,000 children to counter the radical leftists who’ve taken control of our libraries. My opponent's intentionally false attack ad, my stop at Darien Cornfest, promoting school choice with Tim Scott, and talking policy with Doug Burgum. | | | | |
---
| 56 days until Election Day. Here’s an update from the campaign trail:
**My Opponent’s Intentionally False Attack Ad** My opponent, Peter Barca, is a career politician who first ran for office in 1984. And he’s made it clear, **he’ll say anything to get elected**.
In his latest attack ad, he makes intentionally false statements about my record.
---
[Click Here to Read More](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=5c7e77a966&e=e907534017)
| I’ve been clear that I support Wisconsin families access to IVF.
**Darien Cornfest** The 63rd annual Darien Cornfest was a blast! If you haven’t been to Cornfest, I highly suggest attending next year. It’s the best roasted corn you’ll find anywhere!
---
| It was great to see so many familiar faces at the parade and festival!
**School Choice Event With Tim Scott** It was great to welcome Tim Scott to Shoreland Lutheran High School in Somers. We talked to current and former students about the importance of school choice programs.
I’m proud to support legislation with Senator Scott that will expand school choice nationwide.
---
| Every child in America deserves access to a great education.
**Agenda 47 Event in Milwaukee** I joined Doug Burgum, Monica Crowley, and Tommy Thompson in Milwaukee to discuss the failed policies of the Biden/Harris Administration.
We know that Republicans have the right policies to lower costs for families and keep our communities safe.

subject: ABC now won't commit to fact-checking Trump in debate. Tell them to reverse this decision.
body:
| | | | |
---
| | |
# [ABC now says it won't commit to fact-checking Trump in debate. Tell them they must.](https://default.salsalabs.org/Te4cce23d-6570-46be-8b27-a6b3ade2d5ac/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| | [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T13ee2a2f-f463-4d97-9e7b-3f45efa83315/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| | | And just like that, [ABC News is now saying](https://default.salsalabs.org/Taf184225-c69f-4bd7-bd8d-7c9dbe5aedac/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) it won't commit to fact-checking the presidential debate and calling out lies in real time. The network is deploying weasel language to avoid responsibility: _" We're not making a commitment to fact-check everything, or fact-check nothing, in either direction. We're there to keep a conversation going, and to facilitate a good solid debate, and that entails a lot of things in terms of asking questions, moving the conversation along, making sure that it's civilized." ([NYT](https://default.salsalabs.org/T04ac7e9b-a396-4e78-861e-33f8231fb3b9/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9))_ **It's a presidential debate, not a tea party. The point is not to be civilized, it's to determine which candidate should be the leader of the free world.** What's the point of having moderators if they're just going to sit there and do nothing when a candidate tells lie after lie after lie?

[**ABC needs to reverse its decision and commit to calling out obvious lies in real time. Add your name, and tell them to do it.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T67776bca-708c-49fb-91ae-88e00d19f948/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

This isn’t just another debate – this is a defining moment for our nation’s future. On one side, we have **Kamala Harris** – a fighter for equality, justice, and the everyday American. The forces of democracy, decency, and dignity will be tested – and **we must be ready to rise to the challenge.** In this moment, let us remember that we are not spectators. United Sovereign Americans filed two litigation (https://d56tDQ04.na1.hubspotlinks.com/Ctc/UD+113/d56tDQ04/VVS4-F2yVf0-W3712Jc5yFWCyW1qZjFf5kPRt6N6YWdsz3lcq-W6N1vHY6lZ3lSW6KbXsf3qjVzxN1f1fZyZqzD5VGPk1w2vC615W5VFxqp2D2h_JV3YBqX7t0XGvMWgb61xxmzQW7BWJYX30tn5dVhGrKf21sBbPW559YJT7cNBZNW1XRF2646vRLRW1n4hwx51Hsk1VfNSYY6dncL3W8_hNR42kXsWLW8rHwF11thYs9VS0j3F4Hb_yTW3VF6ml6JX9PQW6dTXnQ98X7NqN2-djV46LzQtW3LDCHm36jq_CN6NyK19mTm89W6PB5bR4Kp3tFN1TMvF73_3Y4f3LBJs404 ) actions in Colorado and Georgia on September 9, 2024, for a combined total of nine lawsuits filed since March 2024.

USA initiated their strategy (https://d56tDQ04.na1.hubspotlinks.com/Ctc/UD+113/d56tDQ04/VVS4-F2yVf0-W3712Jc5yFWCyW1qZjFf5kPRt6N6YWdsz3lcq-W6N1vHY6lZ3mmW5tjmFj2P9Dy5VLStXk4MCWDwVXLFQk55VqrWW3qx00j1zfx_9W95X6-D3xryVdW4kRQgs1BJxnLVVBV524VyDHcV9lKL08sWfh_W6KM2wf3LbZNDW3vlCkJ9kTBfGW5SyRPC2F2b14W4My7st8ChXJJW257C1r501rTQW7Mr33y8s32WrW84JTXH62Ypf7W2rDGN-8lsFy6W9b7-NB2SxmM5W4G_Jbl74ykx6W9m3NtX18xYdSW1vQwcc1Sp6tlW2D4sym2SXZ_cV9wrP35jmF5ff8K1fcF04 ) to save this country in March when Maryland filed a federal lawsuit against state and federal election officials. In quick succession, eight more similar federal suits were filed in Pennsylvania, Ohio, Florida, Texas, Michigan, North Carolina, Colorado and Georgia.

Within the lawsuits, USA submits evidence (https://d56tDQ04.na1.hubspotlinks.com/Ctc/UD+113/d56tDQ04/VVS4-F2yVf0-W3712Jc5yFWCyW1qZjFf5kPRt6N6YWdsz3lcq-W6N1vHY6lZ3mmW5tjmFj2P9Dy5VLStXk4MCWDwVXLFQk55VqrWW3qx00j1zfx_9W95X6-D3xryVdW4kRQgs1BJxnLVVBV524VyDHcV9lKL08sWfh_W6KM2wf3LbZNDW3vlCkJ9kTBfGW5SyRPC2F2b14W4My7st8ChXJJW257C1r501rTQW7Mr33y8s32WrW84JTXH62Ypf7W2rDGN-8lsFy6W9b7-NB2SxmM5W4G_Jbl74ykx6W9m3NtX18xYdSW1vQwcc1Sp6tlW2D4sym2SXZ_cV9wrP35jmF5ff8K1fcF04 ) supporting claims that a shocking number of apparent election violations are occurring in fatally broken election systems. These lawsuits ask the court to force state officials to conform to federal law requirements prior to the 2024 election, and to continue to adhere to those requirements in subsequent federal elections.

The lawsuits’ foundation is built upon meticulous analysis by USA volunteers of official state registration databases and voter participation histories. By partnering the law and their forensic investigations, volunteers and attorneys detail potential fraud in the administration and certification of the 2022 mid-term elections.

The observed errors are not anomalies, they are potential felonies. The errors are not isolated instances but rather have been observed across the country in no fewer than 20 states. USA volunteers have sent reports of their disturbing findings to officials, yet officials seem to be nonresponsive to the people they purport to represent.

For example, State Election Validity Scorecards seek to answer this question: “Was the number of ballots in error valid according to the Help America Vote Act of 2002?” Congress defines the ballot error threshold as 1 error in 125,000 ballots. Election Validity Scorecards from nine states show apparent voting violations exceeding this Congressionally defined ballot error threshold for that state:

Georgia:

239,000+ apparent violations, GA 32 errors allowed;

Colorado:

100,000+ apparent violations, CO 21 errors allowed;

369,000+ apparent violations, MI 36 errors allowed;

North Carolina:

579,000+ apparent violations, NC 30 errors allowed;

196,000+ apparent violations, TX 65 errors allowed;

205,000+ apparent violations, FL 62 errors allowed;

Pennsylvania:

1 million+ apparent violations, PA 44 errors allowed;

Dear Friend,

Your participation in Hillsdale
College's National Survey on the United States Supreme Court is
requested.

Your response will only take a few
minutes, but the subject is crucial to the future of liberty and
the separation of powers in America.

The American Founders thought that the
proper role of the Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution.

But progressives see the Court
differently. They want activist judges to legislate from the
bench.

Do you agree that the role of the
Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution as it is written and
NOT to make laws or advance a particular policy agenda?

YES

NO

Even worse, progressives dismayed by
recent Supreme Court decisions want to "pack" the bench with
additional justices to advance a preferred policy agenda.

As Sen. Elizabeth Warren (D-Mass.) put
it in a Boston Globe op-ed: "To restore balance and integrity to
a broken institution, Congress must expand the Supreme Court by
four or more seats."

That is why I'm reaching out to you
today...

What is your opinion about the Supreme
Court's role in our constitutional republic?

Please share your thoughts with me
using the College's National Survey on the United States Supreme
Court right away.

Your response will help Hillsdale form
effective strategies to educate millions of Americans about the
importance of the Constitution to liberty-including the proper
role of an independent judiciary that applies the Constitution
instead of legislating from the bench.

## Trump, Harris Set to Debate Tonight
Former President Donald Trump and Vice President Kamala Harris [will meet tonight in Philadelphia](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGO6yAQAL_G7oh2FwxxQfGadHntldbaXgInHCzMxbq_P-XqK0fTjObjPt055fR8_OdNfAtl4qWll0yjQlBkJtOvPoiQ6F48OhpGZ-0V--gxgLOLIKHISLNc9SgyyLqC2IHm0CdPQAZGBASwg7sEx6iFzQwWtXFDZ0DW1Eq9fJb0bFFC_i4vqZelbH32sbX96PS_jm4d3Xh_ynm81RtqS0uWjm6rzNxExXKqVtTJbYkqcq3pUK1-bbsyFICDvQYa3OgYyDqxGgg1Ihu99NWv-5lyTod1nYHHxin_FrS_f7w8_QQAAP__LA5glw) for their first matchup as nominees.The ABC News debate, moderated by David Muir and Linsey Davis, comes as [recent polls have](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLtu7CAUAL8GOla8sQuK27jb26a0sDmGE2FYYbKr_H20qVOPRiPNx329ByxY0_9wgh9HW8M-8AnrzARnUq-aRn8ASFAUvHDSzM7aSdDsjXDWiNlqq6ctwMSt1nZTE7fqMLuJFL3kUvNZcMG5Ne52uCAUBL1xK5R2hmgOEUfrt8-GdWQ4ynd7Qr_t7aTF5zEeF1H_iFyIXEaGjKW8GZFLbidUeF1ELns4HwFTJXLRk-NKTCyH3vFiXzVCjy2xCFsYwF6hV6yJXZjq26Tdx8cLS8HLOqJ5OgP-Buj4e8XTy58AAAD__175X7Y) Trump gaining on Harris, including a New York Times/Siena College poll showing Trump leading nationally by 1 point.[Both campaigns have agreed](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDFv-yAUxD8N3rDggU0YGP7SX97Spao6Ws_4EVOREAF1lG9fOV0r3fS7G-7u8zyfMaZ4u7zhlVwLeUbf4k6z5VJw0LPuVheIgFRHThoYrBnHk-w2BwK08UabxQY4adTDArB4hOCHQ118RYSVQgoxDqYPBqUi1IsYpdJmYFrQGlsu_VeOt7ZRSM-8U-l9vnbJba3dK1P_GEwMJlz8jR61v-TDZjB9vP9SfmBeKBFWqrx8J6q80r0dC1ZasBHfsJRYGUy15fJkaoorU_-lVEJaK2xX3Hp_xJRiHQ3T4nLFmF4t2t-f7A5-AgAA__9uymI3) to no audience, controlled microphones, and moderator-only questions. Trump won a coin toss for the closing statement order, while Harris selected her podium position.These were the same rules as at the first presidential debate between Trump and President Biden. Biden's performance was so poor that he pulled out of the race in favor of Harris.
## Actor James Earl Jones Dead at 93
James Earl Jones, the Tony-winning actor [known for his iconic voice](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDGPtCAUAH8Ndhh4oGhB8TV2-7VXmic8VjYoGyCa-_eXvfq6SaaYZL4e6wNjiufzPx5kW8gruhYvWmcuBQe96s7bQASkOrLSwDCbcZxkt1szCXJTUBj0OEybAyPQb3JSHmY1BOqiBQFazFJIIcbB9MGgVIR6E6NU2gxMC_Kx5dK_cjzbTiF954tK7_LRJbu39q5M_WOwMFju--7dVk-668czWD7IYHnhQZUTlsRf-aTKfaTK8Ul8Vhxdy4V7LG3nF3oqDJauWP--Y0qxjoZp8Twwpt9m-_vAZeEnAAD__yxxXe8) as Darth Vader in the "Star Wars" franchise, has died at 93.Jones was born in Mississippi in January 1931. [Overcoming a childhood stammer](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj71u9CAQAJ8GurOW5dcFxde4u69NaWG83JFgc7KRUd4-utTpRhpppPm4z_eQS94f_8NGvqU6h9jyRfN4E3BDNSu--kSEJDl5YVGP1hgn-NOLiCTGBKvUymhwAUnDkhyRGoWWimePgApGAQLAaDskG4SkoBYwQiqrmQJac6vH8Fnz3p6Uyne96Bhi3Xjxz9ZeJ5P_GE4Mp977sCzx7RhOO_WT4RSOlmOhN0Zy4vh6ONtd5YdfXz2Xkk9jmYLHFnL5rba_Hy-PPwEAAP__8T9SKQ), Jones developed his distinctive voice while working to manage his speech impediment.The acclaimed actor went on to win numerous accolades, including Emmy and Tony Awards, a Grammy, and an honorary Oscar.The actor starred in dozens of films, including _Field of Dreams_ , _Coming to America_ , _Conan the Barbarian_ , and _The Lion King_. [You can see Jones' life in photos here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxszzGPtCAQgOFfAx0bGMDRguJr7PZrrzSzMqwYFKPEy_37y1199Vu8eT6e05Nyyfv7P20cWqoTzS3fPA3KaAVucjKGxAxsJQeD4Afsut7IJXjWiBHJRIcIFJP31rx07GewaSaWOYAGpwejjdadx0dCMpbJvXRnrEMvnOaYWz0fa817WziVr3rz-ZjrJktYWjsuYf8JGAWMB9ej8E8SMK608aWYzqLWuvOlIlNUJSdWeVfHUlu9lEfoBwB5hnh85lLy1aFw-r1RLr-L9jf4DvAdAAD___gzV4M).
## UNESCO Warns Against "Selfie Tourism"
UNESCO warned that ["selfie tourism,"](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDGv4yAQhH-N3RHBGuNQUFzjLtdeaW1gibnDEMEmp_z7J7_6NaNPGunTaP7cthumnMrjNx7kONYNPac3bVYoKUBvegwuEgFNIzm1wGwXY65q3B1MJt6BrF6AgkGtrtoS2NkbDxo9jMmBBC2tkkpKMy-XuKCaCPVdGjXpZR60pJC4tsvfmgrvFPOnvqldfD3G7HbmZx-mXwOsA6zl86ydz2qA9RQPsEp7xkk5Rer8yXQylnBg-9fFqwRqwtfSGQsL3hshixpFoM7t5TnVIjrlmKgLbCS4invG47SMzYXn_5Rz6mYZtHwcmPL3Mv75p7eDrwAAAP__TulqbQ) where travelers visit destinations primarily to take photos for social media, is threatening to destroy some of the world's most iconic sites.The organization said in a statement that the trend has led to overcrowding, environmental degradation, and disrespectful behavior, including trespassing and vandalism.UNESCO urged tourists to [prioritize respect and cultural engagement](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL2O5CAQBp8GZ4waDP4JCC5xNpdeaPVBM-47bCzAsztvv5qNN_mST6qS6s99vSMnPh6_cSfXYl7RN37SOksFUpvVdMFFIk19R06N2s7jMEyq2xwC9nby_UxkI46kaVLRmsmCNzAE6Nhp0AZmBQpgsOMtjqh6QvMXBtWb0QoDFLjlcvuX-WgbxfTKTyo3n_cuua21s4r-l9CL0MtJDU_-pPR-hV7ebKEXmN9jhV6ug6rPsuKrykopMsmWr8J1l1xloNpKfvHxkBvXlgt7TBKPIP2V2lUwyYRH2LH8r0IvXXHh_OCUuA6jMPDYkb_NXfu50tPprwAAAP__3yxqdQ) over capturing the perfect shot, as the damage to historical sites and natural landscapes may be irreversible.The organization also [called on influencers](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz7GO6yAQQNGvgc4WDBhCQfEad3ntlhaxh2QiDBEQW_n71W69_dWVztd1uQZKlO__w46-x7KEtdOBixukGEAvmm8-IgIqjl5amJw15iL5w-sI8SYAttXFSSkBYJ25GKkm58CKwMmDAC2cFFIIM9kx2iAVBn0TRiptJ6YFbtRLHZ-Fcn9gTJ9yYB3XsvPkH72_GlP_GMwM5vM8xx1ze5Z3zSH9NAzmjGdjML8ztrUMDVMkHHp5V2r7sGHrtXwo34dGHRuvfnudlBI1Y5kW9z3Q74j3v-mHh-8AAAD__0MoXG0) to set better examples for their followers to protect these locations and communities.

| Dear Friend, This is the rare email from a political candidate that doesn't ask you to give anything. I'm running for Congress because Texas -- really, all Americans-- need strong, pragmatic voices in Congress. My opponent is an eleven-time incumbent(!!) who hasn't done anything to change the status quo and doesn't even seem that concerned about it. The last thing we need right now is just more of the same -- career politicians who are struggling to keep up but refuse to step down, who've promised everything and delivered nothing. We all know this last Congress was one of the least productive in our nation's history.
The status quo just isn't working for working families.
That's the reason behind what I've been telling folks when I'm out meeting with voters: our district is ready for a new day.
I want to earn your support in this race, so I want to hear from you. I'm here to serve you and your families -- not the other way around.
I know, I know; that's unusual for a candidate. But this campaign is all about making a change for the better. That change starts with listening to what Texans like you really care about, what your family really needs, and what Congress hasn't been doing for them.
Folks, I think our current political situation has a real simple solution. Congress simply has to go back to working FOR us, rather than ON us.
If you have a moment, please reply to this email and let me know the top three issues you think Congress really needs to address, but hasn't. [And when I've earned your support, please consider helping us make change happen by contributing here: ](https://ckzq96gbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001LxJjyJLsU5gAAc8OKvEXM7WYrgX7w2mDmLDTkPSz7avTPvmqp7snMI6fyNjkutQ-Wiz6VWiKkV9eo4SeCs-ZQkAxiYORu7A4n14RIbKrVbWcOzcjQKcnRdz5bLev5EPOm2gAu0xJ0FGfZi2XIm4kgwAqMFd4zObWe5QuhosB7ooo-lwkYjp5n9NQtLsW8aTK5QXXgvOczjly9RBk2fWxmw==&c=oK1DmWQTYhsCmmiYIvZ4fJEw5naTy-RwNGuh3HqZjMDlsEv8KEmYFw==&ch=2nG_6cfpwoeVVUD6xQxtmz5-7dBCtwVrIAeMYgl4x1jmEoxrBkL5VQ==)

clean_body: This is about listening to y'all, and we're changing Texas for the better. | | | | == | == | Dear Friend, This is the rare email from a political candidate that doesn't ask you to give anything. I'm running for Congress because Texas -- really, all Americans-- need strong, pragmatic voices in Congress. My opponent is an eleven-time incumbent(!!) who hasn't done anything to change the status quo and doesn't even seem that concerned about it. The last thing we need right now is just more of the same -- career politicians who are struggling to keep up but refuse to step down, who've promised everything and delivered nothing. We all know this last Congress was one of the least productive in our nation's history. The status quo just isn't working for working families. That's the reason behind what I've been telling folks when I'm out meeting with voters: our district is ready for a new day. I want to earn your support in this race, so I want to hear from you. I'm here to serve you and your families -- not the other way around. I know, I know; that's unusual for a candidate. But this campaign is all about making a change for the better. That change starts with listening to what Texans like you really care about, what your family really needs, and what Congress hasn't been doing for them. Folks, I think our current political situation has a real simple solution. Congress simply has to go back to working FOR us, rather than ON us. name: Ben Samuels
subject: What I learned from OnlyFans stars and Missouri's most famous teachers (Part 2)
body:
Despite the abuse Megan Gaither faced, both as an educator and since, she still wants to teach. We must do more to support teachers and students; I'll share some lessons from our friends in Utah.

| |
---|---|---
| | | Forwarded this email? [Subscribe here](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9iZW5zYW11ZWxzLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.BR8KYba9LpSou0IFqh-img8Ot0qITDpAYe6g3AYORGE?) for more
---
Politics is full of universal truths, axioms, and unquestioned orthodoxy. We're here to take a closer look at some of that.
Welcome to **Not Quite Right ...** Where we break down unchallenged assumptions.
* * *
# [What I learned from OnlyFans stars and Missouri's most famous teachers (Part 2)](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=2440398&post_id=148163521&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTQ4MTYzNTIxLCJpYXQiOjE3MjU5NzA1ODQsImV4cCI6MTcyODU2MjU4NCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTI0NDAzOTgiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.pki8rzsNmZBiy28XudE_QdAYqgiQ2wg2D_qWbQ9Ow9Y)
### Despite the abuse Megan Gaither faced, both as an educator and since, she still wants to teach. We must do more to support teachers and students; I'll share some lessons from our friends in Utah.
| | [Ben Samuels](https://substack.com/@bensamuels)
---
| Sep 10
---
| [](https://substack.com/@bensamuels)
---
---
| | | [](https://substack..09vHkjgx49jCdl1fqp5pDcB-GT7-QJKwSxix0blOmiQ?&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email)
---
| | [READ IN APP](https://open.substack.com/pub/bensamuels/p/lessons-from-megan-gaither-education-missouri-utah?utm_source=email&redirect=app-store)
---
Several weeks ago, [I spoke with Brianna Coppage](https://substack.com/redirect/697181d6-3a6d-43ba-9a9d-26d852c3e21f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), one of the St. Clair High School teachers who lost her job because she'd been making pornographic videos on OnlyFans to help make ends meet. (Since we spoke, she was featured on an _[ABC News](https://substack.com/redirect/aa7e6b62-02b4-4025-b5e9-7d0c6ec90202?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_[ segment](https://substack.com/redirect/aa7e6b62-02b4-4025-b5e9-7d0c6ec90202?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).)
More recently, I met with Megan Gaither--she was [caught up in the same scandal](https://substack.com/redirect/8f6b2610-bcae-46d6-8717-bdd90312ee12?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), having started on OnlyFans for similar reasons. I met with her for the same reason I met with Brianna: her story gives her a national platform that few other teachers have.
We met at a Panera in Washington, Missouri1 to talk about everything that's happened to her in the past year. One thing that was immediately clear: Megan wants to teach again. She trained to be a teacher, and she loves teaching.
[Listen now * 1:20](https://substack.com/redirect/af01103d-1b1a-44ad-b853-f51cfb1a7bc1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
---
But the last year has been hard for her, because her time on OnlyFans--one that has been lucrative for her--may have closed off a career in education.
We also spoke about the lack of support from school administrators, even though she loves St. Clair, her students, and most of the parents in the community.
As I did with Brianna, I spoke with Megan about student debt and the crisis that it's created for teachers. We also spoke about bad pay, the need for better support for educators, and the treatment she's faced--what amounts to online abuse at times--while teaching and since.
[Subscribe now](https://substack.com/redirect/ce3d7d14-eea2-4002-9342-b1e782e2e449?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
### Fewer people are becoming teachers
The number of people who are becoming teachers in this country has been [declining precipitously](https://substack.com/redirect/d1327a36-112f-4097-be74-cd93150444cc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for two decades.
There are different theories for why this is happening. Based on my conversations [with Brianna](https://substack.com/redirect/697181d6-3a6d-43ba-9a9d-26d852c3e21f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and with Megan, there are three that I will focus on in particular:
1. Pay is too low.
2. The hurdles to becoming a teacher are too high.
3. [Respect for teachers is at an all-time low](https://substack.com/redirect/dd813304-08ba-4cc2-b4ba-2c92845a3990?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and respectful conduct in and around the classroom--from students, from parents, from administrators, and from the community--all feel like they're getting worse. [Teachers have the highest burnout rate of any profession in the U.S.](https://substack.com/redirect/29e3f57a-e190-4de3-a57b-c298a4211efb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

### Paying teachers more
Respect for teachers may be at an all-time low, but even still, most Americans agree that [we aren't paying them enough](https://substack.com/redirect/e49e0882-0082-4e99-badc-9248f670bd4f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
In Part 1, I said that while Missouri should ideally be paying its teachers more, [it's probably not realistic](https://substack.com/redirect/6b95b416-de88-443a-8bf7-24239d2144db?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). (Not at the scale where it could make a lasting difference, at least.) Since then, the State Legislature is seriously considering a plan to subsidize renovations to the Chiefs', Royals', and Cardinals' stadiums, [potentially to the tune of $1 billion](https://substack.com/redirect/50331e7f-95e8-4c18-99d8-24c0a95ac3c4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). This is, of course, insane.2
On the one hand, there are [68,700 public school teachers in Missouri](https://substack.com/redirect/799f953a-c892-4e52-9d77-cb59e0736274?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and rather than spend taxpayer money subsidizing the [Hunt family](https://substack.com/redirect/da5d9f1d-4ab4-4021-aa21-afc7672a2c3e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg),3 who own the Chiefs and [whose collective net worth is $25 billion](https://substack.com/redirect/744d17a9-4253-4dd2-a3f1-6f1df2fa5e1b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), we could literally give every teacher in Missouri a $14,500 one-time bonus.
On the other, what we need are lasting answers, not one-off bonuses. **If we 're about to spend $1 billion of taxpayer money, I'd much rather use it to set up some retention bonuses for teachers**, but even that is not fundamentally enough to change the crisis in education.
### Reducing the hurdles to becoming a teacher
Brianna has a master's degree; Megan has two. Listen to her discuss her decision to start creating content on OnlyFans, as she faced increasing student debt obligations.
[Listen now * 1:44](https://substack.com/redirect/af01103d-1b1a-44ad-b853-f51cfb1a7bc1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
---
I'll reiterate [what I said last time](https://substack.com/redirect/0d89eec3-3834-4a39-889a-2ef23ce29a79?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg): confronted with the reality of paying off student debt, paying off housing, and paying for childcare, I'm extremely sympathetic to their decisions to do what they're doing on OnlyFans. There just aren't a lot of good options.
Policymakers have to find ways to reduce the burdens as best they can.
Some of this--housing affordability, childcare affordability, etc.--are important but separate topics. But one we can address: we have to make it easier for people to become teachers.
In [every state in the country](https://substack.com/redirect/23e31297-4d8b-45fb-a7ab-29faf551648d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), teachers are required to get a bachelor's degree. But doing so is very expensive. According to data from the National Education Association, 45% of teachers have student loan debt, and the [average debt burden is $55,800](https://substack.com/redirect/bbd096a5-8a95-41e9-9191-fd8a528bd579?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--consistent with what Megan and Brianna were paying down.
With [fewer Americans going to college](https://substack.com/redirect/d05c067a-db99-4b97-bc67-75d3d5a11dff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and with fewer teachers entering the workforce generally, the solution here is to **allow more people to teach with associate 's degrees rather than bachelor's degrees**. It will open up the pool of talent to a broader set of the population, and it's a de-facto double-digit-percent raise for teachers carrying debt.4
Not for nothing, this would have a particularly positive impact in rural areas, where [fewer people are getting bachelor's degrees](https://substack.com/redirect/47dac13d-dd20-4b99-9ca7-cc1a8919a6e8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and the people [who are getting college degrees are more likely to leave](https://substack.com/redirect/1f6ed450-3f91-439d-b8af-1a1184105986?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Some people, like Megan, choose to move home to teach, but when the pay is lower and the opportunities are greater elsewhere, many others make different decisions.
[Listen now * 1:58](https://substack.com/redirect/af01103d-1b1a-44ad-b853-f51cfb1a7bc1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
---
### Greater respect for teachers
#### Getting better support from administrators
Megan talked about having almost no support from school administrators when she started teaching at St. Clair High School.
[Listen now * 1:14](https://substack.com/redirect/af01103d-1b1a-44ad-b853-f51cfb1a7bc1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
---
Much broader than that issue, however, is a lack of support from school administrators in the face of in-classroom challenges, confronting difficult parents, etc. We've all experienced greater hostility and antipathy out in the community since the pandemic; we've all seen videos and read stories of local school boards, once sleepy affairs, [turning into all-out culture war brawls](https://substack.com/redirect/141d9da4-868b-4816-832c-062a1fcd45f3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Listening to Megan, Brianna, and other teachers I know,5 it's no surprise that the burnout is high.
#### Utah is doing something right. What can we learn from them?
Utah stands alone in strong student outcomes without spending much:
* By any number of metrics--from [average SAT scores](https://substack.com/redirect/ce79b9aa-c0e0-4943-b47b-369a7c4a8fc6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) (4th) to [eighth-grade reading proficiency](https://substack.com/redirect/79655d72-a592-4be1-b4f4-7704c1ec9a28?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) (3rd) to [standardized test scores in math](https://substack.com/redirect/8ea76888-7e0d-41cf-aa5f-d162da892615?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) (2nd) to [high school graduation rates](https://substack.com/redirect/229d0f9b-3d4c-4f53-8568-e12424e85395?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) (15th) to [squishy subjective ratings](https://substack.com/redirect/8b5d241a-5ae5-4033-b90f-951a9ea49d42?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) from _U.S. News & World Report_ (2nd)--Utah is near or at the top of national education rankings.
* Despite this strong track record of educational successes, Utah spent [two decades at the very bottom of per-student spending](https://substack.com/redirect/29ccf1c0-9163-4b5b-ac90-1aed81c8cb66?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Just recently, they [moved up one spot to 50th](https://substack.com/redirect/c5c9f16f-8581-4451-a7c2-8100b5c6d495?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), just ahead of Idaho.6

What has Utah figured out? For starters, just because per-student spending is low doesn't mean that teacher pay is low: Utah is [10th in the country for teacher starting salary and 23rd for average teacher salary](https://substack.com/redirect/21fae11f-dd99-4724-b38b-29eade778cc6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).7 Among other things, this suggests that Utah's overhead and administrative costs are more efficient.
The state, in general, does a lot of things well:
1. Utah is [ranked as the most affordable state](https://substack.com/redirect/0f372568-32fc-48ba-9119-2225270061cb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
2. The state values education. It's hard to get at this exactly, but [51% of parents hold at least a bachelor's degree](https://substack.com/redirect/f3109714-af94-44f0-b1cb-30223d6d1ba0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), 8% above the American median and one of the highest rates in the country.
3. Utah has the [highest rate of children raised in two-parent households](https://substack.com/redirect/f73ac6e1-8960-47da-b20c-b1bef77bd031?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), which [correlates with all sorts of positive life-long outcomes](https://substack.com/redirect/a5c040b2-a5a5-4143-b914-44e7a6c7b2c7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).8
4. Utah has, by far, the [lowest rates of alcohol consumption](https://substack.com/redirect/d6cb9078-f37e-40dd-b04c-77df9f4630a3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of any state9 and among the [lowest drug overdose rates of any state](https://substack.com/redirect/d57b8779-67b7-4505-9572-789f5fb99e45?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Unsurprisingly, it is bad for children to have parents who are [problem drinkers](https://substack.com/redirect/b83ea1df-3860-4564-907c-f0d350abb02f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and/or [drug users](https://substack.com/redirect/c364cd15-7cef-46c6-b933-5e433b6eaaeb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
5. While Utah is somewhat [middle-of-the-pack when it comes to homelessness](https://substack.com/redirect/0dab7d2c-ba6e-4e21-98fa-6930f61d5eb3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), the state is [exceptionally good at addressing child poverty](https://substack.com/redirect/0422543f-ec3f-4127-9219-34be4b659647?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).

In short, some of what Utah does well in education comes from broader children-specific policy successes. And in fairness, some of it comes from LDS-specific cultural dynamics--two-parent households and low rates of substance abuse, specifically--that would be difficult to replicate elsewhere. (Outside of Utah, the [LDS Church](https://substack.com/redirect/d0059f47-2eb5-44b4-8041-ded9423f77a8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) is probably better known as the Mormon Church.)
But I think there's a broader dynamic at play too.
[Subscribed](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9iZW5zYW11ZWxzLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9hY2NvdW50IiwicCI6MTQ4MTYzNTIxLCJzIjoyNDQwMzk4LCJmIjp0cnVlLCJ1Ijo5MDUwMTE5MiwiaWF0IjoxNzI1OTcwNTg0LCJleHAiOjE3Mjg1NjI1ODQsImlzcyI6InB1Yi0wIiwic3ViIjoibGluay1yZWRpcmVjdCJ9.3vew2jD3PHOYpTU6MWO5FaaY8A4QHADKV1IVHlhX_q4?)
#### A culture of mutual respect matters
Lastly--and for obvious reasons, it's hard to get great data on this--I think Utah is on the whole a more community-oriented and kinder place, where the sort of abuse that teachers face at the hands of loud parents and others is less likely.
I'm always reluctant to include statements that can't be backed by hard data. But let me try to give some examples of this:
* These _Forbes_ lists are inexact and imperfect, but on a [ranking of which states are loneliest](https://substack.com/redirect/2ef90f1c-d76a-4eb2-9f54-2e2c61d6d507?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), Utah is dead last (i.e., Utah is the least lonely state).
* Gov. Spencer Cox (R), facing the [political minefield of trans youth in sports](https://substack.com/redirect/1b32aa62-b496-4352-ae6e-9b39924eda4c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), chose to veto a transgender sports ban anyway. It's worth reading [his statement](https://substack.com/redirect/77c04a16-c580-4701-a1ed-5b3f5cad0d61?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), which is long on the sort of empathy we desperately need in politics today.
* During their [2020 gubernatorial campaign](https://substack.com/redirect/8f910eba-cd45-4886-b0b7-58fa7e6226e3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), the Republican nominee (now-Gov. Cox) and the Democratic nominee came together to film a series of ads to [promote](https://substack.com/redirect/8c9b69f7-2aef-4f09-8d00-fee542217599?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) [civility](https://substack.com/redirect/4b35dafd-695b-4253-a047-de33762aa1d9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
* The LDS Church, whose members make up between [55%](https://substack.com/redirect/ebb6cef7-1853-4239-923c-1d7d4b582c27?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and [65%](https://substack.com/redirect/57346407-ef06-4849-a055-23dbb127283f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of Utah's population, takes a [supportive position on gay marriage](https://substack.com/redirect/57bd89d1-9f78-4c3e-a911-84daaa9fc572?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg),10 which is not the case among many other Christian denominations in the U.S.
* Utahns, in [sharp contrast to the rest of the country](https://substack.com/redirect/169b7dac-09f7-433e-9a7c-294947e0df13?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) (and certainly other Republican states), [overwhelmingly support opportunities for foreigners to legally immigrate to the U.S.](https://substack.com/redirect/88b61469-1391-4208-aea0-82c0d118802b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

I'm not saying that there aren't crazy parents in Utah. [Obviously](https://substack.com/redirect/0b7ea590-30a3-4bb2-bd55-64e4ef273a18?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) [there](https://substack.com/redirect/ec8b3411-2dc4-48cf-b12f-0f61bb310552?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) [are](https://substack.com/redirect/ecf17d91-8afa-4ceb-af90-700a3f7c2bb4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Nor am I saying that Utah is perfect; it is not, in a million different ways.11
But places that have fostered community, respect, and policies that help children also--unsurprisingly--have stronger school systems.
To avoid burnout and turnover, **teachers need much more support, both via policy and from people in their communities. And students need teachers who are supported.**
If Megan's and Brianna's experiences are any indication--and beyond their very public OnlyFans exposure, I think they are indicative--Missouri is falling short across almost every dimension.
### "Kindness" isn't something we can make happen by policy. So what can we do?
[Listen now * 0:45](https://substack.com/redirect/af01103d-1b1a-44ad-b853-f51cfb1a7bc1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
---
Megan is right that the loudest voices--which are best-case annoying, and worst-case threatening or dangerous--make up the minority. Most people are fundamentally good, but it's also hard to speak up against the craziest people for fear of incurring their wrath yourself.
I don't fault anyone for that, by the way--especially against the backdrop of a problem that has [gotten more acute since the pandemic](https://substack.com/redirect/93d6822e-88ad-4e10-a4f0-93275b205977?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
There are some policy solutions here to make things better for teachers and, therefore, for students:
1. Reducing the burdens to becoming a teacher by opening up the field to people with associate's degrees.
2. Doing more to [address teacher burnout](https://substack.com/redirect/dcf6cf64-96f7-4d52-81e2-232f2c4d43f0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg): more mental health support, for instance. With vacancy and turnover rates as high as they are, reducing the burden to becoming a teacher helps with this too. I'm skeptical that the whole don't-fund-stadiums-to-increase-teacher-pay gambit I mention above is realistic, but I _do_ think that money could be spent to reduce the burdens on teachers in ways that would be productive for educators and students.
3. A much broader topic, but the [crisis of loneliness](https://substack.com/redirect/fd45c4d2-ca80-4cc6-8e41-08fd0da89845?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) is driving a lot of the meanness and crazy we see today. There's so much to be done here--I'll write more on that topic later.

But I'll conclude with something that isn't policy: kindness goes a long way. I'm not asking everyone here to agree with Megan's and Brianna's decisions, nor to agree with what I write, nor to share my views or politics.
And there _is_ reason to be hopeful. **The overwhelming majority of Americans --93% to be precise--[believe that they practice kindness](https://substack.com/redirect/74e3ca63-376f-47df-b328-abef9f3ce26c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). And yet most Americans don't see that goodness in others**, believing everyone else isn't as kind as they are.12 In politics and beyond, a little more compassion and belief in the collective good would go a long way.
I'll close with a quote from a man with whom I disagree often, Republican [Utah Governor Spencer Cox](https://substack.com/redirect/77c04a16-c580-4701-a1ed-5b3f5cad0d61?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg): "When in doubt however, I always try to err on the side of kindness, mercy and compassion."

More to come on the topic of sports gambling...

subject: ☕Coffee w/ the Chairman

body:
Presidential Debate TONIGHT - 8pm Central | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/d2d8ab4d8c66/n41kepo7ku-12710915?e=25844e23a8)
---
| | [ ](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=7dbab4fb1f&e=25844e23a8)
---
| |
#### Good Morning Republicans,

**1 Corinthians 3:16** _Don't you realize that all of you together are the temple of God and that the Spirit of God lives in you?_

All of US together.

I believe the key component of this message is **WHAT** are _WE_ together _ON_? It's clear in the many letters that Paul writes that he wants us to be together on God, but he expresses it more as unity on the principles and values of the Words of God because that is the essence OF God.

Our principles...the Party Platform HAS to be the guiding documents we use to connect the party to volunteers, volunteers to voters, voters to candidates, candidates to good legislation or individual actions as an elected representative. If we as Republicans see a concern for our communities and solutions needed (educations, taxes, elections, infrastructure, economic growth, etc.)...THEN we must ALWAYS begin by reading our Platform for guidance and the lens to which we frame the questions and answers.

Any other effort is to believe that just by SAYING the word "Conservative" or "Moderate" or "America First" we have given the DEFINING and VALID construct with which the truth will arise.

No... we must use our Constitutions AND our Principles (Platform) as the source of TRUTH. And ultimately use and intertwine our Faith as the pathway to His will being done.

As I always end my coffee newsletters, THIS truth shall truly set us free. Never stop fighting for the TRUTH!
* * *
We have been working diligently to bring fruition to the 2024 Political and Legislative Vision and our ability for success in November. In many of my "Coffee" emails, I've tried to convey the national presence we now have in the Republican Party of Nebraska. We have political creditability which is never more apparant by all the relationships we've built.

It is a new day in Nebraska Politics especially for the Republican Party. This party has returned to serving its membership (The People), who support the objectives of the party, and the principles with which we represent. We have to STAND firm and not bow to the Liberal agendas because we don't want to hurt peoples feelings. **We HAVE strong values that resonate with most Nebraskans. **Folks, our challenges are not new and they are not unattainable. But they will require everyone in our party to see the Big Picture and work towards it together day-by-day. I believe that Nebraskans see the Big Picture when it comes to the immediate challenges we face as a State.

✅We have to fix Nebraska's broken property tax system
✅**We have to prioritize election honesty that uses common sense and transparency of voting - Election Accountability and Voter Verification.**
✅We have to grow our economy through job creation and education of work identities
✅We have to strengthen and maintain the amazing rural communities and modernize the infrastructures
✅We have to support our agricultural system, the lifeblood of Nebraska's economy
✅We have to restore educational basics, safety of classrooms, and the excellence of Nebraska values, so our kids take ownership of the Nebraska Good Life and stay IN Nebraska.
✅We have to bring respect to Law and Order and address the rising mental health concerns that can easily start in supporting healthy families.

In the coming weeks we will be organizing on all fronts for beyond the election. Our Legislative Plan has very specific bullet points listed above and we will present to Nebraskans specific legislative solutions for our candidates to campaign on. The Platform will guide us and the process will be a purposeful inclusiveness of leaders from all across Nebraska to bring forth the best of Nebraska.

**It's time to be an unapologetic REPUBLICAN!** It's time to be an educated and proactive _[Constitutional](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=8209781e8a&e=25844e23a8) and [Platform](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=0824b04e92&e=25844e23a8) Republican_ (CPR). As a CPR, you will breathe life into our message and the voters will believe in the party as a WHOLE.

We represent the Nebraska 'Good Life'.
We represent life, liberty, and the pursuit of happiness.
We represent the light of Christ which is what the hurting need now.

The NEGOP has achievable goals to connect our [Values](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=1ff54bae8e&e=25844e23a8) to Voters. The **2024 Voter Involvement Plan** is a program designed to engage and involve Republican voters with our CPR candidates. Not all areas will be accomplished and some have a greater level of impact...but we have to endure. **This takes ALL of us to make it achievable!**
Whatever you do...DON'T wait for someone else. You are who God is calling to make a difference. [900 DEMOCRATS](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=34eb393225&e=25844e23a8), just like their presidential SELECTED (not elected)
**are controlling your _school systems, your taxing authorities, your electric boards, your higher education like UNL and Community Colleges_...these LOCAL races are WINNABLE by YOU! You can no longer wait for legislation or federal TO change your local politics.**

Local changes LOCAL [](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=d73b0d2c05&e=25844e23a8)
It's time to get off the couch, off the computer, off the recliner.

You HAVE to knock on a door to save your country.🇺🇲
You HAVE to write a letter of introduction, or thank you, or invite for a candidate to save your country.
You HAVE to give our local Republican candidates $10 more dollars so they can print more signs, or handouts, and buy more stamps to save YOUR country.
You HAVE to help us find EVERY Republican who gets an early ballot and remind them to VOTE!

We will call them, text them, mail them, and even stop by to shake their hand...**but we will leave no Republican voter behind!**

The truth shall set us free.

With much blessings,
---
|
---
| –Chairman Underwood

|

One of our MAIN priorities this year is **Nebraska Board of Education** campaigns. This year we have the opportunity to have a conservative majority for the first time in living memory. If that happens, every school district will see dramatic improvement in reading and math scores by prioritizing the basics of education.

Liz, Linda, & Lisa have been **ENDORSED by the NEGOP** and an expansive, growing list of Nebraska leaders. Let's ensure all Nebraska Voters meet our candidates. Approximately **40,000 Nebraska Voters** will make a difference in THREE campaigns this year and we NEED your help to connect to them. Each mailer costs about **.50 cents after PRINTING and using our BULK MAIL permit**. With your **$50 donation** we can mail **100 cards** and with $20,000 total, we could mail out to EVERY voter on our list! So, **[donate by September 25th](https://gop.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=9c5e4a0a84&e=25844e23a8)** and we can get this mailer out _ASAP_ before EARLY ballots and help our Conservative Republican SBOE candidates WIN.

Our goal is $20,000 in the next 15 days. I know we can do this.

THANK YOU ever so much!

\--Chairman Eric Underwood

body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1891%2E135344%2ERZdE5x)

Friend --
Like many of you, I will be watching tonight's debate between Kamala Harris and Donald Trump.
I am hopeful that they will use the time to address many of the very real issues impacting Michiganders and all Americans in this election. Having watched President Trump debate several times before, I am concerned it will devolve into petty attacks and name-calling from the former president. That would be unfortunate; the American people deserve better, and our kids will be watching and hearing about this debate to be the next president.
But the truth is, I don't have to see any more from Donald Trump to know that he is unfit to lead our nation as president and as Commander in Chief again.
His anti-worker policies threaten to hurt Michiganders and the middle class. He and his judicial appointments would set the reproductive rights of women and families across this country back even further. His environmental policies and threats to roll back any progress made over the last several years threaten the habitability of our country and our planet. And as someone who barricaded herself in her office on January 6th, when he incited violence and insurrection, his attacks on our democracy should be disqualifying.
For better or worse, the outcome of the presidential election and my election are tied together. The better Trump does, the worse it is for our Senate campaign. The better we do, the more we ensure that Trump does not win Michigan -- and, by extension, the White House.
And at the end of the day, both control of the White House and the Senate run through Michigan.
So if you are anxiously awaiting tonight's debate and looking to do something that will make a difference, here's my ask:
[**Make a contribution to my campaign for Senate in Michigan. We will use your donation to help turn out the voters I need to win this race, and the voters who will defeat Donald Trump this November.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-june24.nyVfY7&refcode=em240910-1&t=2&akid=1891%2E135344%2ERZdE5x)

Good morning and happy Primary Day!
With a big cup of coffee in hand, I’m on my way to visit _as many_ polling locations in Delaware as possible to make one final push to connect with voters before they cast their ballots. But I wanted to take a moment to reach out to you first.

Homelessness. Dropping out of high school. Being a teenage mom.
