USO Supporter,
Signing a card -- it only takes a moment and may feel like a small gesture, but it will mean so much to service members who, like all Americans, are reflecting on the horrific events of Sept. 11, 2001, this week.
For so many in the military community, that day was a turning point. Thousands were immediately deployed to defend our country, and countless others were inspired to join our Armed Forces. These American heroes deserve our deepest gratitude and respect.
Newer service members weren't there to witness the absolute shock, confusion and terror of that day, or the wave of unity and patriotism that followed. But the bravery of those who enlisted and deployed into harm's way to selflessly protect the United States and its freedoms continues to inspire. **We hope you 'll be inspired to show your gratitude for all who continue to sacrifice so much to protect our freedom by signing our card today.**
[SIGN THE CARD TO THANK OUR HEROES](https://links.e.uso.)
---
As we all reflect on this life-changing day in history, we hope you'll help us reach our goal of 50,000 signatures honoring service members by Sept. 11 to make sure they know, without a doubt, that Americans like you are with them no matter what. It may not seem like much, but at this somber moment, your words of encouragement and strength can make a world of difference.
**[Please, will you take the time to remember our heroes making immense sacrifices to defend our country? Add your name before midnight to show them you care.](https://links.e.uso.)**
[THANK A HERO](https://links.e.uso.)
---
Thank you for supporting our heroes, today, tomorrow and always.

name: jdavidswift@aol.com
subject: Volunteers needed for Tom Carle's Campaign!! Will you help? * respect for our opponent *
body:
Hi, Everyone,

I am new to this list of Tommy's supporters.

I live in Perrysburg, northwest Cattaraugus County between Forestville and Gowanda near our indigenous neighbors on the Cattaraugus Territory of the Seneca Nation.

I agree with Mr. David Baker to not be disrespectful to our opponents, especially not disparaging their family names.

Nick Langworthy has been doing a good job in communicating with his constituents and on some local issues, and respectful towards my associates who have expressed disagreement with his votes. I disagree with his ideas on immigration, economic and foreign policy, and unqualified support of ex-president Donald, that is why I support Tom Carle whose issues statements I support.

Very glad that we have a choice, Tom Carle, a very-qualified person of integrity to vote for.

Best Wishes to you as you volunteer for Tommy, it would be wonderful to have him as our Member of Congress,

J. David Swift
Born and raised in Buffalo
UB graduate (math)
USAF Veteran
Member of Veterans for Peace
Retired adjunct lecturer in physics and astronomy at SUNY Fredonia
Former high school and college math teacher
Former computer programmer/analyst
Retired National Park guide (seasonal)
Nature Sanctuary Society of WNY volunteer

On Tuesday, September 10, 2024 at 08:36:16 AM EDT, David Baker <bakerdg16@gmail.com> wrote:

I will work the phone and canvas.
Please don't call names. That puts you down on Trump's level.

On Mon, Sep 9, 2024, 23:49 [phonebanking@carle4congress.com](mailto:phonebanking@carle4congress.com) <[phonebanking@carle4congress.com](mailto:phonebanking@carle4congress.com)> wrote:

>
> Hello Democrats!

> Tom's campaign has seen new energy in the last four weeks and the drive to victory is on! Thank you for your donations and interest in volunteering for Tom. There's work to do. The campaign is kicking off it's phone banking operation this week and is looking for volunteers to canvass. If you are interesting in helping out, please reply to this email as soon as you are able. You can simply help share Tom's campaign material online with all your friends on social media. This includes commercial shorts, Tik Tok reels and flyers. Time is short so don't wait. If you would like digital campaign materials emailed to you please indicate that in your reply. I will reach out personally. Thank you again and lets defeat Nick Langworthy ... and the rest of ... MAGA ... this November!
>
>
>
> Best Regards
>
> Matthew J. Podoba
> **Political Advisor/Social Media Outreach Coordinator@**
> **Tom Carle for Congress
>
> **

| _**AN URGENT MESSAGE FROM THE DESK OF DONALD TRUMP JR.**_
---
Friend,

As I’ve said before, when it comes to stopping the Democrats’ Weaponized Lawfare, simply playing defense won’t be enough to secure the rights of the American people.
---
**_We need to take the offensive to hold the guilty Democrats accountable and ensure this kind of Third-World Marxist tyranny _NEVER_ happens again in our country! _**

That is why my father is going to court yet again... _But this time, it’s Biden and his accomplices who will be the defendants!_

**He’s taking the Deep State thugs at Biden’s corrupt Department of Justice to court over their dangerous and illegal raid at his Mar-a-Lago home.**

**_Fox News: Trump to sue DOJ for $100M over Mar-a-Lago raid, alleging 'political persecution'_**
---
This despicable raid was performed with clear intent to engage in an unprecedented political persecution of Joe Biden’s leading political opponent...
---
_...and the FBI agents who carried out the raid were even authorized to use deadly force!_
---
Communism has finally reached America’s shores – and unless we act now to roll it back by holding these left-wing tyrants accountable, our __free__ Republic will remain one step away from collapse.
---
As my father takes Biden and his Deep State thugs to court to ensure they can NEVER illegally raid the homes of their political opponents again, it’s vital that grassroots Americans like YOU have his back.
---
**So, I’ve teamed up with our House GOP Chair, Rep. Elise Stefanik, to gather 50,000,000 petition signatures from grassroots Americans for our _NATIONAL PETITION_ in support of his lawsuit. **

Taking Biden’s DOJ to court isn’t just about standing up for my father’s rights.

If Biden and his Deep State thugs were to suffer no repercussions for this illegal raid, it would only encourage them to do it again – **_and next time, they could be kicking down _YOUR_ door!_**

body:
Hertel negotiated a secret deal with a CCP-controlled company to get $175 million in taxpayer money | | | [](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=66e04a0fdfeb914e01d40e96&u=https%3A%2F%2Ftombarrettforcongress.com%2F%3Fss_source%3Dsscampaigns%26ss_campaign_id%3D66e0301f93df4766eccd6a28%26ss_email_id%3D66e04a0fdfeb914e01d40e96%26ss_campaign_name%3DCurtis%2BHertel%2Bhas%2BDisqualified%2BHimself%2Bfrom%2BCongress%26ss_campaign_sent_date%3D2024-09-10T13%253A32%253A18Z&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&c=b_66e0301f93df4766eccd6a28&l=en-US&s=1z5LB-hk7TNL3DI0wM9QYnn3Mw4%3D)
---
| **Curtis Hertel has Disqualified Himself from Congress**
---
| [](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=66e04a0fdfeb914e01d40e96&u=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.winred.com%2Fbarrett-brigade-victory-fund%2Fcorrupt-curtis&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&c=b_66e0301f93df4766eccd6a28&l=en-US&s=fNycVlx9sa73kcOmbIQcQUgiSxU%3D)
---
Curtis Hertel, Jr., a political insider who served 22-years in elected office before becoming Governor Gretchen Whitmer’s chief lobbyist, and Democratic candidate for Congress, has disqualified himself from serving in Congress by acting as an agent for a Chinese-controlled company.As a member of the Senate Democratic leadership, Hertel and his chief of staff signed Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDA) to secretly negotiate with Chinese Communist Party (CCP)-controlled company Gotion. The negotiations to give Gotion $175 million in direct cash payments from Michigan taxpayers, in addition to hundreds of millions in other taxpayer-funded incentives, for building an electric vehicle manufacturing facility just 72 miles from Camp Grayling, a U.S. military base that provides training to the Taiwan military.
---
[_ _**Stop Corruption** _ _](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=66e04a0fdfeb914e01d40e96&u=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.winred.com%2Fbarrett-brigade-victory-fund%2Fcorrupt-curtis&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&c=b_66e0301f93df4766eccd6a28&l=en-US&s=fNycVlx9sa73kcOmbIQcQUgiSxU%3D)
---
|
---
Then-Senator Hertel signed the NDA along with other legislators to hide the deal from their colleagues in the state legislature, who voted to approve the funding. The funding came from a Whitmer-created program, SSDI/SSI, Outreach, Access, and Recovery (SOAR), designed to provide billions in taxpayer money to global corporations to purse Whitmer’s economic priorities. When the SOAR package came to the floor, policymakers were unaware that the beneficiaries had already been chosen by Hertel and his friends.Whitmer appointed Hertel as her chief lobbyist after he was termed out and he worked to get the final steps of the funding approved by his former colleagues, using the revolving door to work as an agent of Gotion and against the interests of Michigan taxpayers.“The only NDA I’ve ever signed was for my security clearance as a soldier in the United States Army,” said Tom Barrett, a 22-year veteran. “It is incredible that an elected official whose job is to work for the American taxpayers, was instead operating as an agent of a CCP-controlled company, and against the interests of the United States.”
---
[_ _**Stop China** _ _](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=66e04a0fdfeb914e01d40e96&u=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.winred.com%2Fbarrett-brigade-victory-fund%2Fcorrupt-curtis&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&c=b_66e0301f93df4766eccd6a28&l=en-US&s=fNycVlx9sa73kcOmbIQcQUgiSxU%3D)
---
It was also revealed that Hertel received financial support from Gotion’s registered foreign agent, as revealed in the Foreign Agents Registration Act (FARA) filings, required of any American individual or company working on behalf of a foreign interest.“In Congress, I will co-sponsor legislation like Congressman John Moolenaar’s bill, HR 6175, the No Official Giveaways Of Taxpayers’ Income to Oppressive Nations (NO GOTION) Act, which would disqualify companies based in China, Iran, North Korea, and Russia from receiving green energy production tax credits established in the IRA, which will come before the House this week,” continued Barrett. “Americans should not have to wonder if their elected leaders are working for them or our foreign adversaries and Curtis Hertel’s actions have effectively disqualified him from serving.”Chinese operatives have been working to infiltrate themselves into every echelon of American government. Just last month, a former top aide to New York Governor Kathy Hochul, was [arrested for working as an agent of the Chinese government.](https://a1e0.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=66e04a0fdfeb914e01d40e96&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.cnbc.com%2F2024%2F09%2F03%2Fhochul-new-york-aide-china-arrested-agent.html&w=618846223a022e7ecb41d30c&c=b_66e0301f93df4766eccd6a28&l=en-US&s=U_oPP2VrG7ekFpnjKAAuwi5YPh8%3D)

name: Heidi Ganahl
subject: The Mountain Minute: 9/10/2024
body:
Solution to Aurora’s TdA gang problem was presented in bill Democrats killed, Rep. Holtorf says
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi folks,
I celebrated my birthday yesterday and wore this [super fun t-shirt](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) I got at Tucker Carlson last week! This is the Mountain Minute for Tuesday, September 10, 2024.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Heidi will be speaking at Wide Open Saloon on Sunday, September 15th alongside Congresswoman Lauren Boebert and candidates like John Fabbricatore and Valdamar Archuleta. There will be a [great band](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), drinks, food, and fun!
[RSVP FOR FREE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
| | |
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Solution to Aurora’s TdA gang problem was presented in bill Democrats killed, Rep. Holtorf says](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
A measure which could potentially have preempted the arrival of violent Venezuelan prison gang Tren de Aragua in Aurora, Denver and other locations of the state was never given a chance by Democrats, state Rep. Richard Holtorf, R-Akron, says.
He authored House Bill 24-1128, with the support of Sen. Mark Baisley, and an 8-3 party-line committee vote in the 74th Legislature prevented it from ever reaching the floor for debate.
“They wholeheartedly rejected it on principle, a bad, progressive principle of open borders,” Holtorf said.
The bill sought to return Colorado to immigration policy prior to 2013, when Senate Bill 06-090 was in place. Doing so would have eliminated present law prohibiting a probation officer from providing personal information about an illegal immigrant to federal immigration authorities, prohibiting state and local entities from contracting with private immigration detention services, and would have allowed local law enforcement to work with federal immigration authorities.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Biden-Harris Admin ignored repeated military warnings ahead of disastrous Afghan withdrawal](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [NATIONAL REVIEW](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* A congressional report criticizes President Biden for insisting on a complete withdrawal from Afghanistan, ignoring warnings from military and NATO allies, which facilitated the Taliban's rapid takeover.
* The report accuses senior State Department officials of disregarding the Taliban's non-compliance with the Doha Agreement and military advice on withdrawal timelines, contributing to the chaotic evacuation.
* It highlights the administration's prioritization of political optics over security, leading to inadequate evacuation planning and the abandonment of critical intelligence materials.
* The mishandled withdrawal compromised the safety of Americans and Afghan allies and strengthened terrorist operations in Afghanistan.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[‘No politics’ classical school opened by conservative school board rocks Colorado tests](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE FEDERALIST](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Merit Academy, established in 2021 due to concerns over COVID-19 impacts and politicization in public schools, has recorded the highest state test scores in its district among available choices in the Woodland Park area.
* The creation of Merit Academy was driven by Teller County parents who then took control of their local school board to ensure the school's continuation and growth.
* The academy has shown impressive academic performance, leading in both English and math scores across multiple districts, despite broader struggles in Colorado with learning recovery post-lockdown.
* The school board remains committed to supporting high achievement and parental choice in education, evidenced by Merit Academy's success and initiatives like performance-based raises for teachers.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[‘This is troubling’: Aurora officials heavily redact landlord eviction records, citing ‘work product’](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [DENVER GAZETTE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Aurora officials heavily redacted emails concerning eviction actions at the Aspen Grove apartment complex, labeling them as "attorney work product."
* Legal experts argue that these redactions do not meet the criteria for protection under the Colorado Open Records Act (CORA), suggesting that the city's claims are unfounded.
* The redactions follow a landlord's unresolved complaints about Venezuelan gang activity at the property, which were initially dismissed but later acknowledged by city officials.
* The city resolved the situation by dismissing charges against the property owner in exchange for property disposal and assuming costs for securing the building.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Colorado Christian receives handwritten letter from Israeli PM Benjamin Netanyahu](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE JERUSALEM POST](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu sent a handwritten letter to Colorado Christian University to thank them for their support of Israel and Jewish students.
* The letter was delivered to Chancellor Donald Sweeting during a visit to Israel, where he was working with the Herzl Institute to develop a course on the political philosophy of the Hebrew Bible.
* The course aims to address the perceived lack of knowledge about Israel and the Bible among current students, part of the university's broader effort to counter rising antisemitism and politicization in academia.
* Colorado Christian University plans to continue supporting Israel through educational initiatives and public events, emphasizing inclusivity and diversity in line with biblical principles.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Child trafficking educational summit in Colorado Springs to present solutions](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO SPRINGS GAZETTE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The summit on September 20-21 in Colorado Springs features speakers like HHS whistleblower Tara Rodas and Ret. Army Lt. General Michael T. Flynn, focusing on combating child trafficking.
* Discussions will cover the mishandling of unaccompanied minors by the U.S. government, specifically cases where children were placed with criminal sponsors.
* The event is part of the "Get in the Fight" campaign by America’s Future, aiming to educate the public on preventing child trafficking and advocating for policy changes.
* Attendees will learn to identify signs of child exploitation and trafficking and receive tools for community involvement and response.

[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[Harris finally adds policy page to campaign website, devotes several sections to Trump](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [FOX NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Kamala Harris has updated her campaign website with detailed policy proposals across economic, justice, and national security sectors, following her formal nomination acceptance.
* The policies emphasize tax reforms favoring the middle class, proposing cuts for families and increased taxes on wealthy Americans and corporations, aiming to boost economic equity.

| Friends,
Like many of you, I'll be watching the debate tonight in Pennsylvania with Katie and the kids - well most of them, Abby will probably just be crashing her scooter around.
But really folks, this could be one of the most pivotal moments of the presidential election.
Why? Because for the first time this cycle, the Democratic party will be held accountable by the voters - they will actually see this person for the FIRST TIME.
They didn't elect Kamala. They misled us about Joe Biden's competency and health, then quietly replaced him in the dead of the night.
They knew this would happen and ran him anyway--straight out of the Pelosi/Obama playbook.
---
| [](https://bcu8ldbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001R-ZnKBl19Hb3m7YAKbBxJ8oM0FmjeEnZRocF8dwW-l5uojvwGZ8nvxDcrjkviGuFUZQJYGonXNc9AhmFqKHb7fq-r7J3ZNbGS9Hx2Dlgl0BiO1RtiBx4-1UpoM_4NBWurHRl1qMg-xOjzUXsmdjceXmhV4U_q09_LRZV5j3r6Qn2HgmGmiwmplZEcisMbNBTQJUBRguY95JPTfng412jztduDT0Rc92pZ8y7WKlqbYo=&c=1Xg4Na68vR3bSIaB2UBi10xS2h4fOKUplp4oW3XvTXfokZfJJAW5XA==&ch=0pII3r7X517PFxS1teJWQJv9_P6M_7S3lXZKp2XzEbHa9PZxqUdrsw==)
---
You've heard this before.
Remember, "If you like your plan, you can keep it"? Or passing bills before we knew what was in them?
They did the same thing with the President of the United States. That's a dangerous precedent.
Here's why -- the Democrats always have something else up their sleeve they aren't tell you.
Everything people need to know is here:
---
| [](https://bcu8ldbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001R-ZnKBl19Hb3m7YAKbBxJ8oM0FmjeEnZRocF8dwW-l5uojvwGZ8nvxDcrjkviGuFUZQJYGonXNc9AhmFqKHb7fq-r7J3ZNbGS9Hx2Dlgl0BiO1RtiBx4-1UpoM_4NBWurHRl1qMg-xOjzUXsmdjceXmhV4U_q09_LRZV5j3r6Qn2HgmGmiwmplZEcisMbNBTQJUBRguY95JPTfng412jztduDT0Rc92pZ8y7WKlqbYo=&c=1Xg4Na68vR3bSIaB2UBi10xS2h4fOKUplp4oW3XvTXfokZfJJAW5XA==&ch=0pII3r7X517PFxS1teJWQJv9_P6M_7S3lXZKp2XzEbHa9PZxqUdrsw==)
---
| That's the real Kamala Harris. The one she's going to try to hide tonight.
They've been dishonest at almost every turn. But tonight, Kamala Harris will have to face these issues standing beside President Trump.
This must stop. In 2024, we have to act. That's why we're launching a massive ad campaign to inform voters. If we don't stop Kamala, things will only get worse.

---
| And that doesn't stop with her.
That's also why we're focusing on Pennsylvania and working to unseat Bob Casey Jr.--a carbon copy of Kamala Harris and a robot for the Obama/Pelosi agenda to silence conservatives forever
Right now, the race is neck and neck, and trending in the wrong direction. Of all the swing states, Pennsylvania is crucial.
Why? Casey Jr. is riding on his father's legacy as a "blue dog" Democrat who could be reasoned with, but he's pushing the same far-left agenda as Kamala.
Just watch this video we're airing in Pennsylvania with D1 swimmer Paula Scanlon: Women showering with men.
No difference between Casey Jr. and Kamala.
Watch the PA video:

---
| [](https://bcu8ldbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001R-ZnKBl19Hb3m7YAKbBxJ8oM0FmjeEnZRocF8dwW-l5uojvwGZ8nv5Uc2iTDId3zMHoiQ__cLG1LJ6BN1j8oETzp45TX97rLrkqs-ETbjUJUZ0q66T_OwzEB053soHnD2PxFXNepg0zXXutJudMSd71hzsZve1fp_u7FWeqLn-E9-eO4XvHtEA==&c=1Xg4Na68vR3bSIaB2UBi10xS2h4fOKUplp4oW3XvTXfokZfJJAW5XA==&ch=0pII3r7X517PFxS1teJWQJv9_P6M_7S3lXZKp2XzEbHa9PZxqUdrsw==)

| People need to see both of these videos. Paula worked her whole life to be the best swimmer she could be.
Nothing could prepare her to have that lead to showering with a man.
And that's why we need your support in [getting them out. ](https://bcu8ldbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001R-ZnKBl19Hb3m7YAKbBxJ8oM0FmjeEnZRocF8dwW-l5uojvwGZ8nvxDcrjkviGuFUZQJYGonXNc9AhmFqKHb7fq-r7J3ZNbGS9Hx2Dlgl0BiO1RtiBx4-1UpoM_4NBWurHRl1qMg-xOjzUXsmdjceXmhV4U_q09_LRZV5j3r6Qn2HgmGmiwmplZEcisMbNBTQJUBRguY95JPTfng412jztduDT0Rc92pZ8y7WKlqbYo=&c=1Xg4Na68vR3bSIaB2UBi10xS2h4fOKUplp4oW3XvTXfokZfJJAW5XA==&ch=0pII3r7X517PFxS1teJWQJv9_P6M_7S3lXZKp2XzEbHa9PZxqUdrsw==)

# [Tell the debate moderators to ask Trump TOUGH questions about his worst behavior, not BS softball ones that normalize him](https://default.salsalabs.org/T96a8eb70-2a37-47b5-92ba-3918f4dff2a6/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| | [](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tc57c1914-a603-41e3-ae1c-4d546811eca9/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| | | Donald Trump is not a normal candidate. He is an unprecedented threat to our nation who has openly threatened violence, mass arrests, and a dictatorship from day one. [He needs to be challenged directly on these fronts, and America needs to see and hear what a monster he is.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T4c283812-dea8-420a-a5ae-b9e8a37a29dd/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) **And yet, too many reporters have been obsessed with "normalizing" Trump, and covering him like they would any other candidate. They are "sane-washing" him by ignoring the worst, and focusing on esoteric policy issues or other things that make it seem like this is a typical campaign.** The debate will likely be the only one of this campaign between Trump and Harris, and the most watched event to this point. The moderators need to maximize the opportunity, challenge Trump hard, and not waste time on easy questions that might make sense in an alternative timeline and universe. They need to do it. And America needs them to do it. Hi, it’s Jacky Rosen. The story below is a special one about
my faith and how I first got involved in politics. This one means a lot to me, so I hope you’ll take a moment to read it. But if you don’t have the time to take a look right now, could you still split $10 or more between me and Tim Kaine to help us keep the Senate blue? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-rosen]
Derek,
My career in public service began in 2016, when I was recruited to flip a competitive House seat blue. I was serving as the president of Nevada’s largest synagogue, and looking back now, that was incredibly fitting – because my Jewish faith and values have always been at the very core of my work in Congress.
In fact, my decision to run for public office was guided by the Jewish principle of Tikkun Olam – to leave the world a better place than how we found it.
I’m so proud of the progress we've made in the years since. And in the face of growing antisemitism, attacks on reproductive freedom, and threats to tear down our democracy, I'm as committed as ever to making positive change happen. But I need your help.
Right now, polls are showing me locked in a dead heat with my Trump-endorsed opponent – who just set a major GOP fundraising record in the race that will likely decide Senate control. So please, I'm humbly asking:
If you're with me in the fight to continue making progress for the people and communities we love, will you split $20 or more between me and Tim Kaine to help me defend my seat and keep the Senate blue? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-rosen]
If you’ve saved payment info with Actblue Express, your split donation between Jacky Rosen’s campaign and Tim Kaine will be processed immediately.

subject: Can I have your money?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Dan Ruby
body:
https://ruby4or.com/ [https://ruby4or.com/]
Friend,
I hate doing this.
To be clear, I am loving almost every aspect of this campaign so far. I love talking about the issues. I love talking about my plans to move our community forward. I love getting out and meeting you and hearing what you want from our Congress.
But the one part of campaigning that I can’t stand is asking for money. I’m running to serve and support you, not the other way around.
Our current system is a joke. Instead of hearing from the people, politicians go from donor to donor, catering to the rich instead of the masses.
Sadly, raising money is a necessity in our current political system. In order to win, we need to be able to buy ad time, send mailers, and spread word about our campaign. And that takes money.
This a race is tightening, and we can’t afford to fall behind on fundraising. If you could donate anything you can spare to our campaign, it would be greatly appreciated. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/dan-ruby--friends-of-1?refcode=h8this]

or the mess that created Biden?

**FELLOW PATRIOTS:**

We are living in times that demand more from

**We The People**. The signs of the hour are clear: our country is in crisis, and focusing on the symptoms alone isn't enough.

It's not just about cleaning up the mess left by the current administration - it's about addressing the root causes of the deeper problems that got us here in the first place.

**The real job before us is cleaning up the mess that created Biden.**

This is about

**restoring our Constitutional Republic**, ensuring that the principles of freedom, individual rights, and accountability are upheld. But make no mistake - it's up to

**us** to make that happen.

Politicians can't save us.

We must be the

**solution** to these challenges, and

**Texas MAGA Fest** is about uniting patriots with a shared purpose: to take back control of our country and steer it in the right direction.

The urgency of the moment cannot be overstated.

Now is not the time for complacency, but for action. And we believe that

# **September 10th Newsletter**

---
Dear neighbors,
---
| | We are just three months away from the start of the 2025 General Assembly legislative session, and a lot of preparation work is underway. Over the past few weeks, I have met with various constituency groups that call the 25th District home. I look forward to continuing the conversations over the next few months in preparation for the legislative session. Should you have an interest in a particular issue, have identified a challenge within our community, or wish to garner further insight into the legislative process, please feel free to contact my office. My door is open! I am always delighted to meet with constituents. In addition to regional meetings, I will meet with my colleagues serving in the Virginia General Assembly to fine-tune legislation. These opportunities will include participating in a workgroup on my bill to prevent claim sharks from preying on veterans and their hard-earned benefits, discussions on our public education system, and the financial health of our Commonwealth of Virginia. As these meetings get underway, I will share our discussions and findings in future newsletters.
---

During September, we raise awareness of mental health and promote suicide prevention. During this month, various organizations, mental health advocates, and individuals come together to share resources, support, and information to help prevent suicide and provide assistance to those struggling with mental health challenges. To continue conversations about mental health, reduce the stigma surrounding mental illness, and encourage individuals to seek help and support when needed, the students of Forest Park High School will host their 8th annual Suicide Awareness Walk on Saturday, October 5, 2024. The annual event is coordinated by the students. It will feature speakers, and local and state elected officials like myself seeking to make a difference, and will conclude with a 3.2-mile walk. The route will be lined with inspiring messages of hope and statistics. Be sure to mark your calendars as additional information will be shared once available. I hope to see you there!

clean_body: Updates for the 25th District - Sept 10th| | | September 10th Newsletter Dear neighbors, | | We are just three months away from the start of the 2025 General Assembly legislative session, and a lot of preparation work is underway. Over the past few weeks, I have met with various constituency groups that call the 25th District home. I look forward to continuing the conversations over the next few months in preparation for the legislative session. Should you have an interest in a particular issue, have identified a challenge within our community, or wish to garner further insight into the legislative process, please feel free to contact my office. My door is open! I am always delighted to meet with constituents. In addition to regional meetings, I will meet with my colleagues serving in the Virginia General Assembly to fine-tune legislation. These opportunities will include participating in a workgroup on my bill to prevent claim sharks from preying on veterans and their hard-earned benefits, discussions on our public education system, and the financial health of our Commonwealth of Virginia. #
Friend of life,

Did you know that major chains like Walmart, Costco, Kroger, and Albertsons are under pressure to start dispensing the abortion pill in their pharmacies? This alarming trend could soon make your local pharmacy a distributor of drugs specifically designed to end the lives of preborn children.

NYC Comptroller Brad Lander recently issued letters to the CEOs of these major corporations, insisting that they become certified to dispense these deadly pills. Government officials, especially those with long-standing ties to organizations like Planned Parenthood, should not be able to demand this of our pharmacies.

Over 600,000 preborn babies were tragically aborted by the abortion pill last year. This number is only expected to rise if major pharmacies agree to dispense these drugs. Corporations that participate in this are complicit in what can only be described as a genocide of future generations.

Even now, pharmacies like Walgreens, CVS, and Rite Aid that have chosen to distribute the abortion pill are facing backlash from customers who want nothing to do with the abortion industry. We do not want our local grocery stores and pharmacies to become marketplaces of death.

By urging these major chains to resist the pressure, we can protect our communities and ensure that our pharmacies remain places of health, not places of harm.

Will you sign Live Action's petition and urge Walmart, Costco, Kroger, and other major chains to resist dispensing the abortion pill?
**[https://www.liveaction.org/resist-pressure-to-dispense-the-abortion-pill/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=fdd2149718a848d3a1f0a8fe21ffc7b5&_e=SpcUPthhVGoEgMxPBdrKfZL06WuHfnKfWS4YloUCtxzFs2Tp-NpXCk_fdvE5g7cDvBK7mh4okK5iJ1kw70KQ8RfuN86J7P_JaPjNn-7N8VKp-JSbODUb1O_7bhh8N_vJuRb-SXpK9YIOAXQAegkznaqMCGooo34jmfQ_ANp2Lrmi0OmcdasfiI3nry0sNiluqkjFrQDmhT64Q4amqDF8WspNA2q9RgfidtYoehU2zTZYwv5jyKlSbJu8UwBYSEX0LTbW_H_cXtQH37V9Wg_84hdeI3bWdrvZkvd9w3TBxUrCzjE3TvKqADOs4RAm4GSkGN6aOXMaw7EwJRIR-cR89Ml2BkPFEXHUtlbbNSVNIteRGIZt_Ym9pOUSmfvHqYeVvVa-UJGfEKzcNHdJCTPTYQ%3D%3D)**

Let's make it clear that we oppose the distribution of the abortion pill at our pharmacies.

Thank you for standing with us in the fight to embrace life and protect the most vulnerable.

For Life,

Josef Lipp
**Chief Operating Officer**

Folks --
It’s time to ban guns from every polling place in America.
The voting booth should be a sanctuary of democracy. But every election year, we see reports of extremists openly carrying weapons as voters go to the polls – turning what should be a safe and welcoming experience into one of intimidation and fear.
That's why we're taking bold action to protect voters. Just this year, democracy activists like you helped pass laws restricting guns at polling places in New Mexico and Massachusetts – and with your action, we can bring this solution to every state in the nation.
Sign our petition to tell Congress: No guns at the polls! >> [https://act.commoncause.org/petitions/tell-congress-no-guns-at-the-polls-3?source=090324swap-ifvap&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fifvap-actions]

With political tensions running high, it's more important than ever to ensure our polling places remain free from suppression and fear. No matter what you think about gun safety laws, banning guns at the polls is a commonsense step that every American who loves democracy should be able to agree on right now.
Our democracy works best when every voter feels safe and empowered. Voting is meant to be an act of hope – NOT fear – and with your help, we can make that a reality nationwide.

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: JD Vance on his child care “plan”: Maybe grandma and grandpa wants to help out a little bit more
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2335%2E4032634%2EmibRe5)
---
Word salad is on the menu pretty much any time Donald Trump opens his mouth these days. But a recent statement of his — answering a question on how to make child care more affordable — was really something else. I want to quote the whole thing, even though it’s pretty long. Maybe if you take a magnifying glass to it and squint at it sideways, it’ll start to make sense? Maybe there’s a secret, coherent code somewhere in here? _"Well, I would do that, and we’re sitting down. You know, I was somebody — we had, Senator Marco Rubio, and my daughter Ivanka, was so impactful on that issue. It’s a very important issue._ _"But I think when you talk about the kind of numbers that I’m talking about — that, because look, child care is child care, couldn’t — you know, there’s something — you have to have it in this country. You have to have it. But when you talk about those numbers, compared to the kind of numbers that I’m talking about by taxing foreign nations at levels that they’re not used to. But they’ll get used to it very quickly. And it’s not going to stop them from doing business with us. But they’ll have a very substantial tax when they send product into our country. Those numbers are so much bigger than any numbers that we’re talking about, including child care, that it’s going to take care. We’re going to have — I look forward to having no deficits within a fairly short period of time, coupled with the reductions that I told you about on waste and fraud and all of the other things that are going on in our country._ _"Because I have to stay with child care. I want to stay with child care. But those numbers are small relative to the kind of economic numbers that I’m talking about, including growth, but growth also headed up by what the plan is that I just — that I just told you about. We’re going to be taking in trillions of dollars. And as much as child care is talked about as being expensive, it’s, relatively speaking, not very expensive compared to the kind of numbers will be taking in._ _"We’re going to make this into an incredible country that can afford to take care of its people. And then we’ll worry about the rest of the world. Let’s help other people. But we’re going to take care of our country first. This is about America first. It’s about make America great again. We have to do it because right now, we’re a failing nation. So we’ll take care of it. Thank you. Very good question. Thank you."_ Correct me if I’m wrong, but I’m not seeing any resemblance of a policy proposal in there. His running mate didn’t do much better when he got a similar question last week: _"I think one of the things that we can do is make it easier for family models to choose, or for families to choose whatever model they want, right? So, one of the ways that you might be able to relieve a little bit of pressure on people who are paying so much for daycare is make it so that —**maybe, grandma and grandpa wants to help out a little bit more. Or maybe there’s an aunt or uncle that wants to help out a little bit more.** If that happens you relieve some of the pressure on all the resources that we’re spending in daycare."_ Look: I actually did have a family member, my Aunt Bee, who was able to help me out with child care — a ton. But I also understand that not everyone has an Aunt Bee. A bunch of those grandmas and grandpas would be busy working extra hours for extra years if the far right succeeds in raising the retirement age. And even though Donald Trump seemed to minimize the importance of child care (if there actually was any meaning in that answer), it’s critical, basic infrastructure for our economy. People can’t get to work without roads, bridges, transit — or child care. So I’ve got a plan to put quality, affordable child care within reach for every family in America — while also raising wages for child care workers, who do some of our nation’s most important work. Half of families nationwide would pay no more than $10 a day. We can get this done. As long as we stay in the fight. It takes big, structural change — not word salad, not a kind family member — to solve a big, systemic problem. And it takes the will to get it done. We can’t trust Donald Trump and JD Vance to care enough about these problems that families are facing, and therefore develop real, substantial policies to get those problems solved. But you know who we can trust? Kamala Harris and Tim Walz. If we elect them to the White House, they will work to lower costs for families and make our government work for working people. And I’m running for re-election this November so I can be in those fights right by their side and get these policies passed. I will keep pushing for action on universal child care, housing affordability, abortion rights, anti-corruption reform, and more. But I can’t do it alone. | Last Tuesday afternoon, TFVC began receiving calls, texts and notifications about a Leander ISD father’s Facebook post. In it, the dad - **understandably livid** \- detailed how his son’s name was posted on a projector screen in the cafeteria, along with the names of dozens of other students, during lunch time. Mrs. Diaz, an Assistant Principal at Danielson Middle School, then read off the students’ names and allegedly threatened to **remove them from school if they could not provide updated vaccine records**. Unfortunately, this is not the first time [LISD has been in hot water](https://click.mlsend.com/link/c/YT0yNTY2MTE2NDE1NDk3MDUwOTI4JmM9bzFuMSZlPTAmYj0xMzYwOTgzNzY1JmQ9dDVtOHo4eQ==.-V-30SoUlUm9QBwy65i7x200sTNF9CcQldu9qj2v4us) over disclosing student vaccination information, but this time **the action was intentional**. The school administrators and nurse **refused to take calls from TFVC** , prompting our Political Director Michelle Evans to instead go to local lawmakers and [media](https://click.mlsend.com/link/c/YT0yNTY2MTE2NDE1NDk3MDUwOTI4JmM9bzFuMSZlPTAmYj0xMzYwOTgzNzcxJmQ9dDNyOGkwaA==.vWo2u3fDH0VizGVEm1EidBx4YYFz1V1r_2ixSfpECh4) to hold the district accountable. Let us be clear - **we will not tolerate children having their private medical information exposed and being bullied over this issue**. This is an egregious violation of law and common sense. Obviously, nothing can undo this action, despite the district issuing a weak apology. However, TFVC will pursue legislation in the 89th Session to **hold bad actors within school districts accountable** for misapplying laws regarding vaccine recommendations and violating student and family privacy.

Oregonians have been trying for years to get federal protections for “Oregon’s Grand Canyon” without success — and now Governor Kotek has joined that fight. Not only are the Canyonlands beautiful, but they also hold significance to Tribal nations, generate tourism dollars for the state, and provide a home for wild species native to the area. Protecting our natural landscapes for future generations is a fundamental part of Tina’s environmental policy, and now she needs your help: | Thank you! Kotek HQ | Tina Kotek is working hard to make Oregon a better place to live and work for all Oregonians – and making real progress on issues like housing and homelessness, education and child care, and mental health and addiction services. | "Debate Night in Philadelphia. While the Harris/Walz campaign — and the legacy media — want to present this as debate number one, never forget this is debate number two for President Trump against the Biden/Harris administration. **Kamala Harris has been Vice President for every single day of the Biden presidency** , helping to shape, advocate, and defend every single decision.

She is the Border Czar, so she owns that failure even more than Biden. And when it comes to the humiliating, deadly withdrawal from Afghanistan, never forget Harris told us she was “the last person in the room” with Biden before their plan was launched.

It’s actually worse: Harris has spent the last several months — maybe years — lying to us about Biden’s mental and physical health. In fact, **question number one should be this**..."

As a common-sense conservative thought-leader, Guy’s writings provoke thought on important topics such as education, politics, culture and anti-Semitism. Guy draws on decades of experience from South Philly to the Philadelphia suburbs to Pittsburgh, from Harrisburg to Washington, DC, having served at the highest levels of government, as a candidate and strategist, as well as Chamber CEO. Guy has been listening, observing and guiding his readers for years.

_Broad + Liberty_ advocates for **political, cultural, and economic freedom** in local and regional discourse in Philadelphia and its environs: the suburban collar counties of Southeast Pennsylvania, South and Central New Jersey, and throughout the rest of PA.

In 2022, no one gave my husband Adam Frisch a chance against Lauren Boebert.
Everywhere you looked, the political pundits were calling Colorado’s 3rd congressional district “Safe Republican” or “Solid R.”
Nate Silver’s FiveThirtyEight only gave Adam a 3% chance of defeating Boebert. They projected he’d lose by over 45,000 votes!
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92538874/497455854/1610638071?refcode=em20240910mid-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=3da18bba-8d6f-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&recurring=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzZGExOGJiYS04ZDZmLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=CEXufYyK3mXNKHzDxYWWgURVHFQ-J-N9mYe37bB5hwE=)

| | Peter, A lot has changed this summer, but our race here in IL-17 is still right where it was – dead-center on the Republicans’ road to holding their House majority. Our MAGA extremist opponent, Joe McGraw, was recently named to the NRCC’s “Young Guns” list, and national Republicans spent the summer fundraising for him in preparation for the fall. Speaker Johnson came to the district and called McGraw “one of the best” GOP recruits ever, and said flipping IL-17 is “key to keeping the majority.” Republicans also leaked an internal poll that showed our race tied and tightening. Just a year ago, Democrats had a 6% lead amongst voters. Today, that lead is just 2%, putting our race well within the margin of error. [**Trump won IL-17 in both 2016 and 2020, so a race this tight can go either way in November. Can I count on you to help make sure IL-17 says ‘NO’ to Trump and McGraw by delivering a $ 10 contribution right away? **](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/qon78NwTXKlHcUHRJwTDYA~~/AAUS1gA~/RgRowvU3P0TkaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL2VzLXEzLTIwMjQ_) | **[Donate](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/qon78NwTXKlHcUHRJwTDYA~~/AAUS1gA~/RgRowvU3P0TkaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL2VzLXEzLTIwMjQ_)**
---
As the campaign hits full-swing post-Labor Day, we are bracing for Republican dark money to storm our district with misleading, negative ads, but here’s the good news – we have a game plan. With your support of our campaign, we’ve been able to invest in polling that clearly lays out our path to victory in November and I laid it out for you at the end of this email.
On November 5th, we’re going to win because we’re going to turn out a record number of Democrats and once again persuade swing voters in Central and Northwestern Illinois that I am the trusted, common sense candidate in this race. But it will not be easy, or cheap.
**We’re going to need to fund get-out-the-vote efforts, direct mail, digital ads, and TV commercials to make sure we get our voters and our message out, so I am going to once again need your help.**
[**Can I count on you to help us put our plan to win into action by chipping in $ 10 before our September 30th FEC deadline – the last before our election?**](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/qon78NwTXKlHcUHRJwTDYA~~/AAUS1gA~/RgRowvU3P0TkaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL2VzLXEzLTIwMjQ_)
**[Donate](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/qon78NwTXKlHcUHRJwTDYA~~/AAUS1gA~/RgRowvU3P0TkaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL2VzLXEzLTIwMjQ_)**
---
Thank you for your continued support,
-Eric
**Our Plan to Win in November**
**Step 1: Turn out reliable Democrats.** To have any shot at winning in November, we need to make sure our base of Democratic voters who voted in 2022 and 2020 show up again. That means investing in field operations to get those voters registered to vote-by-mail or vote early, so rain or shine on Election Day, we have their support.

**Step 2: Turn out infrequent Democratic voters.** We know Donald Trump turns out Republican voters who don’t show up in poll numbers. They are an X factor, so we have to create an X factor of our own by turning out other voters Republicans could never expect. To do this, we need to communicate with Democrats who only vote when someone knocks on their door, a good ad interrupts Sunday Night Football, or a friend reminds them to vote.

**Step 3: Persuade swing voters.** This is the hard part and the most critical, and we have to play on two fronts; we have to give voters our positive vision for the future AND defend ourselves against heinous attacks from Republicans. But here’s what our research tells us, which Republicans haven’t figured out yet: IL-17 Voters want a representative they trust, who is not an extremist, and who will protect their basic freedoms. I first ran for Congress because I’d earned the trust of my neighbors from being their meteorologist on TV for 20 years. We won in 2022 and we’ll win again in 2024 because my Republican opponents have been extremists who’ve misled voters and threatened to take away freedoms.

Peter, Whew! Signature collecting for ballot access is a wrap! Just yesterday, we got word that we crossed the finish line in Rhode Island, the very last state where our anti-genocide, pro-worker, climate action campaign was collecting signatures. Jill and Butch will now be an option for **_240 million voters_** across the country. And they have a staggering 517 potential electoral votes, well over the required 270 electoral votes to get a people, planet, and peace administration in the White House. We also have an update on Nevada, where the anti-democratic party is scrambling to subvert democracy by using all the dirty tricks they can. In case you missed it, the office of the Nevada Secretary of State (a Democrat) gave the campaign the wrong forms to use to get on the ballot. Then the dirty Dems used that technicality to sue us off the ballot - we won in lower courts, only to lose in the Nevada Supreme Court. And this just in from our research team: the _**Chief Justice in the case is a DNC donor.**_ But we aren’t giving up. Our lawyers have said that we have a case that the US Supreme Court may take which will make ripples all over the country for ballot access. The process for ballot access is a complete mess and a preposterous waste of resources, and not just for independent campaigns. The amount of time and money spent by local governments trying to navigate the complex laws passed by Republicans and “Democrats” to block us from the ballot is immeasurable. But the expense to the campaign is measurable: we have spent over a million dollars on the fight to give voters a real choice this November. The dirty Dems’ attack on our ballot access in Nevada, when you add up the costs of petitioning and legal fees, has probably cost us over $100,000 for the privilege of having our petitions thrown out by dirty tricks. We can’t miss the opportunity to rectify this waste of time and resources. _**[We need all hands on deck to pay for the legal fees to take this to the US Supreme Court. He is widely recognized for leading the landmark restorations of Congress Hall and the Virginia Hotel in Cape May, and for launching creative programming to dramatically extend Cape May's season, a catalyst for the economic rebirth of one of the Jersey Shore's most beautiful communities. Curtis is a successful businessman and job creator, employing more than 1,000 people in New Jersey and New York. Friends,
Today is Suicide Prevention Day, and it hits close to home for so many in Ohio—especially our veterans and farmers.
Growing up on my uncle’s farm, I saw firsthand the challenges that farmers face, and it breaks my heart to know that farming is now one of the top 10 professions at risk for suicide.
Meanwhile, the veteran suicide crisis is far worse than we ever knew.
The latest data shows that we’re losing 40-44 veterans to suicide every day—a staggering increase from the 22-per-day statistic reported a few years ago.
These are the heroes who have dedicated their lives to protecting and feeding our country, and Jim Jordan should be ASHAMED for how he has completely abandoned them.
Jordan has voted against EVERY Farm Bill since entering Congress, leaving farmers to fend for themselves, and even blocked life-saving legislation that would expand healthcare for veterans struggling with mental health crises.
If we’re going to help those most at risk, we need to step up now. That’s why I’m asking you to donate to our grassroots movement to kick Jim Jordan to the CURB. Your donation of $25, $50, $100 or more today will help us reach more voters and ensure they know the truth about how Jim Jordan has abandoned our farmers and veterans. When I first enrolled at Dallas Theological Seminary, I was searching for answers and unclear about who God was calling me to be. However, through the biblical teaching of faculty, fellowship with the student body, and the guidance of the Holy Spirit, I came to understand that my worth and identity are found solely in Christ. This revelation has changed everything. **That's why I want to share an incredible free resource with you --_In Christ_ by Dr. J. Dwight Pentecost.** It might be tempting for you and me to base our identity in our achievements, status, or in the approval of others. But these are fleeting. If you and I are rooted in Christ, we can enjoy a supernatural sense of peace and joy that transcends understanding. I believe that the message of In Christ is one that will resonate with and encourage you in your own journey of faith.

We have three numbers you need to see:

We need to fight back and set the record straight _right now_. Will you rush a contribution to my campaign?](https://click.everyaction.com/k/92547107/497482935/947007800?refcode=WTEFHU24_GoodlanderSplit2_ND&sourceid=1054808&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRUwvMS84NzA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3YjcxYWYzYy05OTZmLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wFDvdMhL820u_Os-3EBvihu1Dyf4B9jE0MN6C22I3X0=)** The people of New Hampshire expect their candidates to run honest campaigns, and unfortunately, that's not what we've seen from my opponent's campaign.

My opponent has sent out mailers and bought TV ads to try and attack my record and confuse voters on where I stand on some of the most important issues. **But here's the truth:**
1. I'm proud to have served as a foreign policy advisor in the Senate, where I helped write landmark sanctions against Vladimir Putin and comprehensive immigration reform.

2. I understand firsthand what it's like to live in a post-_Roe v. Wade_ America. During my time in the Biden-Harris White House, we created a Reproductive Rights Task Force to defend abortion access across the country, and in Congress, I will continue to fight like hell to protect our reproductive freedom!

body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1901%2E135344%2E-_JPOo)

Friend --
It has been 75 days since we all turned on the TV to watch the first presidential debate between Donald Trump and President Joe Biden — but it feels like a lifetime.
It’s a reminder that *a lot* can happen in a short period of time, so let’s recap everything that has happened since that debate.
59 days ago, there was an assassination attempt at Donald Trump’s rally in Pennsylvania.
57 days ago, Trump named Ohio Senator JD Vance as his running mate.
51 days ago, President Biden made the patriotic decision to step down from the ticket and endorsed Vice President Harris.
35 days ago Vice President Harris announced Governor Tim Walz as her running mate.
We are now 56 days out from Election Day. Absentee voting begins in Michigan in just 16 days.
All year, I have been telling my staff to expect what we in the national security world call “black swan” events — moments that you cannot predict but change everything.
We have certainly seen a few already, and we should expect to see more. As the past few weeks have made clear, a lot can happen in this final stretch.
Like every good operation, we have shown that we are able to adapt to changing circumstances.
So if today is the day where you are considering making a donation to help keep Michigan blue, I hope you are confident that we are a good investment.
[**Ahead of Vice President Harris’s debate with Donald Trump, will you chip in $3 directly to our campaign to turn out the voters we will need to win and support not only our race for the U.S. Senate, but also propel candidates up and down the ticket?**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-sep24.1Cpmdt&refcode=em240910-2&t=2&akid=1901%2E135344%2E-_JPOo)

Peter,
When I was in college, I had to work odd jobs to pay tuition.
I strengthened my right arm while scooping ice cream and exercised my patience while waiting tables. But my favorite job was as a National Park Ranger, giving guided nature and cultural tours — and not just because the uniform had a great hat.
My time as a Park Ranger gave me a deep respect for public service and conservation. I saw firsthand how important our public lands are — not just as sanctuaries for wildlife and precious ecosystems but also as classrooms for the natural world and our cultural heritage.
It’s why I became an environmental lawyer, fighting to address climate change and hold corporate polluters accountable.
It’s why I ran for office, working to secure Arizona’s water supply and make college more affordable.
And it’s why I’m running for Congress now — so I can help bring clean energy jobs to Arizona, lower electricity costs, and build a world where future generations can thrive.
This is one of the most competitive House seats in the country, and my Republican opponent is getting a ton of support from corporate PACs and crypto groups.

Texas A.G. Ken Paxton has now sued Travis County ( Austin ) and Bexar County ( San Antonio ) over their plans to try and register unregistered voters. The suits seek to stop officials in both counties from mailing voter registration applications to non-registered residents of those counties.

| | Please see a special message from our sponsor.
---

| | Dear Friend,Populism is a word often used to describe emerging political trends around the world. But populism isn't just a modern phenomenon -- it goes back centuries.
---
| [](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.)
---
| | Traditionally described as a battle between Left and Right, political differences are actually far more complex. What we are witnessing today are two distinct populist movements challenging party establishments across the West. Remarkably, these tensions can be traced all the way back to Roman times.

This is why I'm reaching out to you today. I want to offer you a free copy of one of our most insightful eBooks: **Dueling Populisms** by Victor Davis Hanson. Hanson, a Hoover Senior Fellow and acclaimed historian, provides a unique perspective that I believe you'll find incredibly valuable.

In **Dueling Populisms** you'll discover:
* What to expect from a political landscape dominated by movements that oppose both the establishment and each other.
* The striking similarities between ancient populist movements and today's progressive and conservative populisms.
* Insights into what the future holds for America as we navigate these revived ancient tensions in our modern culture.

This eBook is especially relevant as we face increasing political polarization and try to anticipate and understand election outcomes. By understanding the historical context of these populist movements, you'll gain a clearer view of our current environment and the potential paths forward. Hanson's expertise will help you see beyond the surface of today's political debates and grasp the deeper currents at play.

Don't miss out on this opportunity to deepen your understanding of today's political dynamics. Get your free copy of **Dueling Populisms** using this secure link: [Get Your Free eBook](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.-rnpgwleNz8ETw)

I hope that it helps equip you to understand and participate in the civic discourse in the coming months.
Greg Greg Stamps | Online DevelopmentHoover Institution | Stanford University

Our Faith for the Future voter registration drive is right around the corner. We still need VOLUNTEERS [] to make it successful! Saturday, October 5th & 12th we will be standing up voter registration tables across the state! When people of faith get to the polls and vote their values, they shape the future of our great nation! Our goal is to host voter registration events in EVERY county in New Jersey! This is no small task and we cannot do it without your support! We need your help: 1. Volunteer: We need passionate volunteers to help us with our voter registration events. If you're interested in volunteering, please click HERE [] to sign up. 2. Donate to the Drive: Your generous donation will enable us to reach our goal of putting a voter registration booth in each and every county in the New Jersey. Every contribution, no matter the size, makes a difference. Please consider donating HERE []. 3. Register to Vote: If you haven't registered, NOW is the time! Visit our website HERE [] to complete your voter registration. It's quick, easy, and an essential step in making your voice heard. Together, we can make a meaningful impact. It's time to unite in faith and action. Mark your calendars and join us in this important endeavor. [] [] [] [] [] [] []

# Debate Ready
### Storm Prep As Well
| | | [Dan Carr](https://substack.com/@dancarr2014)
---
| Sep 10
---
| [](https://substack.com/@dancarr2014)
---
Dear Friend,
Tonight's debate presents a great opportunity for Donald Trump to present his ideas, share his vision, and engage with key issues in front of a broad audience. I am confident that Donald Trump will be able to convey his message clearly and with impact.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/9cb353e8-fe17-4dc8-b448-596599b843c2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
However, I also want to address the hurricane that is approaching us. We must stay informed and prioritize safety, especially as the storm approaches. I encourage everyone to follow weather updates closely, make necessary arrangements, and ensure your families and homes are secure.
While we focus on tonight's event, let's also be mindful of the broader circumstances and be prepared for potential disruptions in the coming days.

| Kamala Harris has been a mentor and friend for more than 14 years, and I often even refer to her as “my quintessential big sister,” because she always shows up for me when I need her. In fact, when I first won my race to become Prince George’s County Executive, one of the first calls I received was from her. I’d like to share one piece of advice that she shared with me: More important than being first at something is to make sure you are not the last. And now that we’re standing on the precipice of electing our country’s first woman president, that advice feels more appropriate than ever. This whole election cycle boils down to this, Peter: Will our country be dragged backward, reverting to an era of fear, overreach, and fewer rights? Or will we come together, build a winning, vibrant coalition of supporters who recognize that we’re stronger, and better, when we come together as a country and embrace progress? That’s why we need to win BOTH the White House and the Senate in November, but it’s going to take the biggest, broadest grassroots movement our state has ever seen, so we’re going to need a lot of resources. Which is why I’m asking: [Can you pitch in a split donation of $25 between my campaign and Blue Amp Action to keep Maryland blue and help propel our country forward?](https://default.salsalabs.org/T2220b364-4383-4bae-87f2-7be14bd9e724/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

The road to a Democratic majority in the House runs straight through Virginia. I’m proud to support strong VA Democrats who are running for U.S. House seats, and I hope you’ll join me by reading these emails and chipping in when you can. With your help, we can flip the House and keep VA blue!
Friends,
Don Beyer has dedicated his life to serving his fellow Virginians, and has always been a strong advocate for protecting and empowering the most vulnerable among us. He’s exactly the kind of leader we need in Congress.
I’m proud to call Don a friend and colleague, and I’m honored to support his re-election campaign to represent the people of Virginia’s 8th Congressional District.
As one of my longtime supporters, I need to ask: Will you split a donation of any amount between me and Don right now to help us win in November? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-beyer]
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-beyer [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-beyer]
U.S. Congressman Don Beyer, Majority Leader of Virginia House of Delegates Charniele Herring, me, and Democratic Party of Virginia Chairwoman Susan Swecker
I’ve worked with Don a lot over the years — we’ve partnered on legislation to avert government shutdowns, fund long COVID research and support, and secure funding for Virginia public transit. No matter the issue, Don is committed to understanding the problems facing Virginians, finding solutions, and delivering progress for more Americans.
When he’s re-elected, I know Don will continue fighting for the things that matter most to his constituents – building a stronger and more equitable economy, passing legislation to prevent gun violence, lowering costs for more Americans, and delivering guaranteed paid family and medical leave for every American worker.
Right now, Don is doing everything he can to continue making progress for Virginians, retake the House majority, and defeat Donald Trump at the ballot box. Please split a donation of any amount between our campaigns, and together we can keep Virginia blue and win big in November. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-beyer]
DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-beyer]
Thanks for your support – and for helping keep Virginia blue.
-Tim Kaine

I want to share one of the MANY powerful testimonies that emerged from Canada. A man was trapped in a cycle of hopelessness and despair. At our revival in Hamilton, God placed a beautiful rainbow in the sky. When the man saw the rainbow and walked outside to get a better look, he heard the music from the Let Us Worship band and words about the faithfulness of God.

From working as a consumer protection lawyer to serving as Attorney General, I’ve been honored to take on big fights for the people of North Carolina — and win. = | = Thank you, Josh Stein

Tonight is the night.
Vice President Kamala Harris and Donald Trump will go head-to-head in the first presidential debate of 2024, and there’s no shortage of high-stakes issues to address.
The future of our democracy, voting rights, reproductive freedom — all of this and more is on the line. But there’s one urgent topic that must not be ignored: **the climate crisis.**
We’ve seen it — record-shattering heat waves, devastating wildfires, rising sea levels threatening entire communities. And as we speak, Big Oil is funneling millions into Trump’s campaign, banking on his return to power to push their dirty agenda.
**The climate crisis is the defining challenge of our generation, and it demands to be addressed on the national stage.**
Will Trump be forced to answer for his cozy relationship with fossil fuel billionaires? Will Kamala Harris lay out bold plans to tackle the climate emergency? These are the questions we need answered tonight.

| | **For Immediate Release:** September 10, 2024
**Contact:**[press@davemin.com](mailto:press@davemin.com)
**Firefighters Endorse Senator Min**
_International Association of Firefighters Joins Police And Teachers In Supporting Dave Min For Congress_
**IRVINE, CA** — Today, Dave Min for Congress announced the support of the International Association of Firefighters (IAFF) and its Local Union 3631, completing the clean sweep of public safety organizations in this race for Min, who has been a strong supporter of law enforcement and fire prevention during his time in the State Senate. Notably, [Senator Min secured nearly $17 million for Orange County firefighters](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=f0b4240408&e=7017cc100e) and facilities during his term.
_"Dave Min has fought for public safety his whole career. As a State Senator, he's worked tirelessly to keep Orange County's families safe, and will continue that work in Washington."_
\- **Frank Líma, IAFF General Secretary Treasurer**

_"Dave Min has consistently prioritized public safety and the investments in wildfire prevention and response we need to keep Californians safe. Dave Min stands with first responders, which is why the 350,000 men and women with IAFF stand with him."_
\- **Chris Hamm, President, Orange County Professional Firefighters Local 3631**
This announcement marks Min as the unanimous choice of police, teachers, and firefighters, who previously announced the endorsements of the Police Officers Research Association of California (PORAC), which represents police in all of the city police departments in CA-47, the Fraternal Order of Police (California Lodge), the Association of Orange County Deputy Sheriffs, the Association of Los Angeles Deputy Sheriffs, the Los Angeles Police Protective League, the California Teachers Association (and its national counterpart the National Education Association), and the California Federation of Teachers (and its national counterpart the American Federation of Teachers).

Min has assembled an impressive coalition of support. In addition to being on the DCCC’s Red to Blue List of priority challengers for the House, Senator Min is endorsed by outgoing Rep. Katie Porter and over 50 local elected officials. He is the consensus choice of Organized Labor, with major endorsements including SEIU, AFSCME, Teamsters, AFL-CIO, and the California Labor Federation. A full endorsement list is available [here](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=8f1ad54cc1&e=7017cc100e). ###

_California’s 47th is an open_[ _DCCC Red To Blue_](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=6abc62f5c2&e=7017cc100e) _Congressional District in Orange County that includes the Cities of Costa Mesa, Huntington Beach, Irvine, Newport Beach, and Seal Beach, and portions of Laguna Beach, Laguna Hills, and Laguna Woods. Incumbent Democratic Representative Katie Porter is not running for re-election. In 2022, Porter defeated former Assemblymember Republican Scott Baugh by 3.44% in this_[ _“toss up”_](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=5c8c5005c5&e=7017cc100e) _district. State Senator Dave Min currently represents over 80% of Congressional District 47 in Sacramento. In 2020, Min received over 158,000 votes within CA-47, defeating incumbent John Moorlach by 5.15% in this area. 19% of the registered voters in CA-47 are of Asian and Pacific Islander descent, including one of the largest Korean-American populations in the country._

| Fellow Patriot,

I feel like our culture has forgotten--or ignored--some very important and basic lessons when it comes to the development of human life.

Our society has been infected by an anti-life ideology, treating its most vulnerable members as disposable objects. Abortion that was once thought of as a last resort in a medical emergency has become the new normal.

Medicine tells us that life begins at the moment of conception. It also tells us when an unborn baby develops a heartbeat, brainwaves, and nervous system. Yet, despite all of this, the unborn are not treated as though they are alive or even human. [](http://links.redconservatives.com/u/click?_t=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_m=c3b1cf882abf49b894a7a77ab3db2263&_e=3vgACM2ncPKrJLLOs9OdT2sMo8sr9N0nZUKL-gWzsWC4q5VPib5wBM3ND6i8lJb3NXFjFpxuwbaE-jOs-B1BKTnVvWZW8ujwRS_mF9AdGPCJMBO2JhTLCNzYAQ1lhev84ILlI1uYQMxeqL2d8tFryk79S-PzbVyieOp-kAMs9_ZpbOOuMP5OX2CED8YdrVMX0dys8gIuDxgQ547gmOm5x8fC7ptbMk24_Blu74CrK2JoX-ETYuRI7X-bIWfYgI9SM5qpXEszlXk6gPaZEwMWXaSWCW5KhRz9A0gB4XkKelY2qEYDObQme1F6OJU7A1SLuCeOnY7WKUmlhKOmpcIauMiyOsR6lJ9wnOub_Wt3ixRo6VBJ25_iohB1R2RX6PwJ9mIcUU0fL5BxvToiNgR8J7ocC-wILqUSTTX-8ptLKwc%3D) **As a surgeon, I have operated on infants pre-birth. I can assure you that they are very much alive.**

Life is a precious gift that has been given to us from our creator. No person is disposable, and every life is precious according to Him.

I believe that everyone deserves life, even those who have been denied this right by our society. I believe that together we can make a difference and bring dignity and a voice to the unborn. I also believe that I'm not alone in this belief.

I believe that you believe that too.

I've started working with a group of like-minded individuals who are looking to change our culture. We want to build a society that values life but that takes people like you and I making a commitment.

The first step is clearly stating what we believe and what we are willing to do to protect the lives of the unborn. **[**Will you join me today and stand up for those who cannot do it for themselves?**](http://links.redconservatives.com/u/click?_t=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_m=c3b1cf882abf49b894a7a77ab3db2263&_e=3vgACM2ncPKrJLLOs9OdT2sMo8sr9N0nZUKL-gWzsWC4q5VPib5wBM3ND6i8lJb3NXFjFpxuwbaE-jOs-B1BKTnVvWZW8ujwRS_mF9AdGPCJMBO2JhTLCNzYAQ1lhev84ILlI1uYQMxeqL2d8tFryk79S-PzbVyieOp-kAMs9_ZpbOOuMP5OX2CED8YdrVMX0dys8gIuDxgQ547gmOm5x8fC7ptbMk24_Blu74CrK2JoX-ETYuRI7X-bIWfYgI9SM5qpXEszlXk6gPaZEwMWXTBVVY5t1NjhLNeSnhLCp8uwMqYUU3T1IAxrCWp8QPro7o0mIc1icfCy38FOgc43O0UvLhI5q2LA00HMyyHbboOTmgEoDSNomM_QR58B65BAqGA-Op1X6SiJUCvqNjIY501BlEm-aPm-ZVsEoTMjgo4%3D)**

I've created a new pro-life pledge; I'd love your support. Would you read the pledge below to see if you align with our shared goals and are willing to commit to fighting for the lives of the unborn?

[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/pro-life-statement/](http://links.redconservatives.com/u/click?_t=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_m=c3b1cf882abf49b894a7a77ab3db2263&_e=3vgACM2ncPKrJLLOs9OdT2sMo8sr9N0nZUKL-gWzsWC4q5VPib5wBM3ND6i8lJb3NXFjFpxuwbaE-jOs-B1BKTnVvWZW8ujwRS_mF9AdGPCJMBO2JhTLCNzYAQ1lhev84ILlI1uYQMxeqL2d8tFryk79S-PzbVyieOp-kAMs9_ZpbOOuMP5OX2CED8YdrVMX0dys8gIuDxgQ547gmOm5x8fC7ptbMk24_Blu74CrK2JoX-ETYuRI7X-bIWfYgI9SM5qpXEszlXk6gPaZEwMWXbxK10ZSIFQ_Be4OJYQoAUrCGyDLT6EJg01dRstlOkaz6yu308GChBsGnmqQ5T9GKDRBWPP4ikBYBRgbqm2WkDCMVQ0rmkXnJ-3eBZXOQeAcbpUAdUZjkgx0ztcdzoV0Y3mhHrnNpUiV4lZ-_19zpmY%3D)

Hey Charleston!

My friends at the Gaillard Center have some exciting kid-friendly, democracy-themed events planned in the weeks leading up to the election on November 5.

If you are looking for something to do with your kids (other than canvass and vote:)), check out the details below!

It’s never too early for kids to start learning about why our democracy is worth fighting for.

Until the kids are alright,

Annie

* * *
Navigating the democratic ideals of our nation can be challenging, especially for parents trying to guide their children through these complex concepts. In times of uncertainty, the arts can offer a powerful means of understanding and connection. This fall, in the lead up to and following the Election, the Charleston Gaillard Center is presenting [Fall for Democracy](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.xqm-apKpWqGuZCDDu9wrxUJ2AASXdR8Mqwc5QcqV3qAGV8qCjNDR_h3utva510pMeJyTKWNjc_Xy74Q2hQAc8Cb1WPsiPAFiMnoYMoI7jqZcQUho5vH9h6a2y23T1nus2_OT9UAiprotjsS004-Fi3DBm5D6ud7SLGdK14ov7HxJpSGu4PTVVXZI2TgoAFJ7PixW0gc5b1Lfzj6X8n0Tw-_Xvh17oRCiapq2J8IFE7AwhCBZw60yVJYfRuylmwTJ83R4hLNpUiKUMS_O0YCdtdvjWuTwj1LKTi014lesj17ej_yRaSQlSqcmul8xzdtg-V-SKlLWDboTlZxoqmbMAA/49n/J_MtukMhS8eNUYmpIQu4bQ/h0/h001._BxWIUkh21bNpU29PMD5ta5VdJtf-vAo9pfK2XQkAPQ). This program, featuring performances, speakers, and panels, is designed to provide a platform for every voice, fostering open and thoughtful dialogue.

_[Fight Night](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.xqm-apKpWqGuZCDDu9wrxUJ2AASXdR8Mqwc5QcqV3qBjy1C1OKvakLISHB7BN-2eGDc1Ixvm5P2A8cxZHiv7PV6O8uSLG7EPmr7736nEUZS4AGgBmUV8PpvdmD_ytlcbtU9-tJBGzOwlQRc5sr3XqPn7J_H7Lo7gYLF-Stg0wql7Plhy6udPlEgl85GytnkC2OkP4-mnd1aQJasdCCJv8AhM7_4LIglXYMeEcTNSMtd6BE_u_0kpHN_vJSyoqts0n8BsUwP4_uansMaJPDNWMFJwkzOLRphP7jRMZTFq_LPV0KGlfTVVTdRRBqeLAhhah_VIQLotrhcQeCg7LpxJa8bRbVia5GWgEsWlL5r0QKU/49n/J_MtukMhS8eNUYmpIQu4bQ/h1/h001.HCKMBHvVZUrf0lXEWbNGt2EQXPDLm1GGdnzxhAMOj5o) _(September 12 and 13): a fun, interactive play exploring the concept of voting and the collective conscious (for middle school age and above)

Tim Kaine and I believe in a future where every person has the opportunity not just to get by, but to get ahead.
Where no child has to grow up in poverty. Where every worker has the freedom to join a union. Where every person has affordable health care, child care, and paid leave. Where every senior can retire with dignity.

America has tried these failed policies before. We are not going back.

Tim Kaine has spent his entire career fighting to improve the lives of everyday Virginians, and he knows there is more to be done.

She won in 2022 because she built a broad coalition of Michiganders focused on the issues that matter most: lowering costs, investing in better futures for our kids, and protecting abortion rights.
