As president of our local union, I led the strike.
_[Click here to stop receiving emails about Dan Osborn's campaign in Nebraska from us.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92556652/497515692/1647001491?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyOTM5YjA0MS1hZjZmLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=JKtqrIg39-aK3vhKNQDUmZH0WnUPVW5lkvSYw5lHE1U=&emci=be57017d-9c6f-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&emdi=2939b041-af6f-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&ceid=19445147)_
Hey there,
In October 2021, I had been an employee of Kellogg’s for almost 18 years.
I had dropped out of college and gone to work for the company after my wife got pregnant. Life’s easy when all you gotta do is take care of yourself – but we had diapers to buy and needed health insurance for our growing family.
When I applied in 2004, there were 6 positions and 600 applications. Working at Kellogg’s promised to be a lifelong career. A good-paying job that afforded me the opportunity to become a homeowner, let my wife stay home with the kids, live decently, retire some day, and hopefully live happily ever after.
But over the years, wages became a two-tier system. New workers were being paid less than workers had made decades earlier. Cost of living adjustments weren’t keeping up anywhere near inflation. Retirement and health insurance plans had been gutted. It just wasn’t right. They were making record profits – and doing it off the backs of workers.
**So in October 2021, we walked out. And as president of our local union, I led the strike.**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92556654/497515694/92586991?refcode=em20240910pm-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=2939b041-af6f-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&recurring=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyOTM5YjA0MS1hZjZmLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=JKtqrIg39-aK3vhKNQDUmZH0WnUPVW5lkvSYw5lHE1U=)
It was the first time many of us had ever walked a picket line. It was cold, but we were determined to hold our lines even through the dead of the winter if we had to. Every worker knew we were a part of something bigger than ourselves. We were in a fight for the future of the American middle class.
After 11 weeks, and the company threatening to permanently replace every union worker, we reached an agreement. More importantly, we saved 500 good-paying jobs here in Nebraska alone.
It was one of the proudest moments of my life.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92556656/497515696/92586991?refcode=em20240910pm-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=2939b041-af6f-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&recurring=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyOTM5YjA0MS1hZjZmLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=JKtqrIg39-aK3vhKNQDUmZH0WnUPVW5lkvSYw5lHE1U=)
Following the strike, I was fired. The company has its version of events for why, but I believe it was because I was union president. Someone had to pay – and my head was on the chopping block.
It’s easy to let yourself get beaten down by life. To let big corporations and the politicians they own in Washington make all the decisions – and just accept that that’s how things will always be. But that’s not me.
**Instead, I’ve decided to run against one of the most corporate politicians – U.S. Senator Republican Deb Fischer – and with your help, we are going to defeat her.**
FIVE polls now show me neck-and-neck with Republican Deb Fischer, and in one poll, I am even LEADING her by 2 points.
**I am ready to take on Republican Senator Deb Fischer just like I took on Kellogg’s. But I sure as hell am not going to take money from corporate PACs, so I need grassroots donors like you to give now if we’re going to win this Senate seat.**
**[Please, will you make a donation to my campaign for U.S. Senate right now – whatever you can afford – to help me defeat Republican Deb Fischer and win this Senate seat in November?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92556658/497515698/92586991?refcode=em20240910pm-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=2939b041-af6f-ef11-991a-6045bdd9e096&recurring=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyOTM5YjA0MS1hZjZmLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=JKtqrIg39-aK3vhKNQDUmZH0WnUPVW5lkvSYw5lHE1U=)**

But that’s not me. Instead, I’ve decided to run against one of the most corporate politicians – U.S. Senator Republican Deb Fischer – and with your help, we are going to defeat her. FIVE polls now show me neck-and-neck with Republican Deb Fischer, and in one poll, I am even LEADING her by 2 points. I am ready to take on Republican Senator Deb Fischer just like I took on Kellogg’s. But I sure as hell am not going to take money from corporate PACs, so I need grassroots donors like you to give now if we’re going to win this Senate seat. = Please use the links in this email to start a weekly donation through ActBlue: | | = | = | | = | = | | = | = I believe we can win this race and keep up the fight for the American middle class. I’m counting on your support to win. Thank you, Dan Osborn ** Paid for by Adam for Colorado. The primary race for Director of Public Lands came down to less than 50 votes between second and third place. Every. Vote. Matters. We must be our own heroes to ensure Eastern Washington elects a pro-labor, pro-choice, pro-common sense solutions representative to speak for us in Congress. If you can contribute your time or money in any way, you are one of the heroes we need - no experience (or cape) necessary!

We saw significant gains, in voter turn out and in votes for Carmela, in precincts we canvassed for the primary election. We must reach every county in WA05 to win this election, and we can’t do it without grassroots support.

| | Tomorrow evening's debate in Pennsylvania between Vice President Harris and Donald Trump will highlight how critical the Keystone State is to not just winning the White House, but also to holding on to the democratic majority in the US Senate.

### Let's Make Minnesota Affordable Again!
---
Polls show the economy and rising prices are the top issues on voters' minds heading into the election. Minnesotans, and all Americans, need relief from the rising cost of living.

This is why Making Minnesota Affordable Again will be my top priority in Congress.

As I’ve examined the problem, I’ve found four things Congress can do to help lower prices for Minnesotans and all Americans.

I will work to put these policies in place to halt rising prices and return us to an era of economic security:

**Cut Wasteful Federal Spending. **
The spending spree of the last four years must end. It’s time to cut fraud, waste, and the abuse of federal funds and adopt disciplined spending measures that help families and support economic growth.

**Increase Access to Clean and Affordable Energy.**
Energy touches everything we grow, manufacture, ship, and consume. When energy costs rise, so do the prices for everything else, making access to clean and affordable energy a key component of economic recovery.

**Reduce Taxes.**
Minnesota’s families, seniors receiving Social Security, and people working for tips need relief from high taxes. People need to be able to keep more of their hard-earned money.

**Create High-Paying Jobs.**
Higher wages and robust job opportunities are vital to ensuring economic security for all Minnesotans. We need policies that create a regulatory and tax environment that encourages businesses to invest in communities and create high-paying jobs.

It’s time to tackle the high cost of living for the people in Minnesota’s 3rd District. I look forward to working with colleagues from both sides of the aisle to achieve this goal.

**If you want to join the effort to Make Minnesota Affordable Again, I invite you to click below to find ways to get involved in our campaign. We need your help!**

A couple weeks ago, we received an email from David Sacks followed by another from the Trump 47 Committee inviting us to his latest fundraiser for the Trump Campaign. Solomon and I had previously attended his get-together with President Trump in San Francisco. This new event was for JD Vance at the Sacks family home in the LA area. (If you haven't read one of my newsletters in a while, among other things, Solomon is working with the finance arm of the Trump campaign, to which we affectionately refer as the T47C.) I'm thrilled that some in the high-tech industry are coming out for Trump; this shift is huge.

The venue changed for security reasons and after a text from David Sacks, RFK Jr. was added to the speaker list. When I learned we'd be able to attend a private policy-based discussion prior to the usual reception activities, my mind immediately went to our wildfires in Oregon. Anything affecting our loggers, farmers and ranchers to the degree we're seeing is critical - a national security risk IMO. Our food supply must be protected. I believe key changes are vital both in the USDA and within the Department of the Interior.

Four chairs were lined up against the wall: Usha Vance, JD Vance, RFK Jr. and David Sacks. Facing those about 6' away were two short rows. We were in the front row directly facing JD and RFK Jr. Cell phones were locked away so people could speak freely. I was seated between Solomon and a former Chair of the New York Stock Exchange. Maybe 20 people were in the room.

RFK Jr. talked about when he started speaking with President Trump himself, he learned how extensive the media's misportrayal had been, and how many key issues they had in common. The Democrat and Republican parties have slowly reversed over the decades again, it seems. The 50% of Americans who voted for Biden represented 70% of the major wealth in the U.S. The half who voted for Trump represented 30%. The Democrats represent most of the industrial war complex. The Republicans don't. Republicans are about free speech. Democrats are about censorship.

This inversion was made crystal clear recently. We got Bobby. They got Dick Cheney. The Never-Trumpers and neocons are now absolutely part of the Democrat Party. I think we got the best side of that trade!

I certainly haven't agreed with all of RFK Jr.'s policies, specifically on 2A rights and "climate change," but I also learned firsthand that his ideas also aren't quite as portrayed in the media either. For example, he's not favorable toward things like carbon credits and the WEF-driven agenda. He's against the windfarms off the Oregon coast, in another example, due to their effects on whales. (I'm against them for a wide range of disastrous issues.)

The conversation drifted into the small profit margin earned by farmers and ranchers, the decrease in small family farms and ranches and the takeover of mega meat packers and conglomerates. The loss of productive lands, including those acquired by the CCP right next to military bases, is also a huge national security issue. My observation is that the Trump administration will be headed in the right direction on these issues, but having grown up on a ranch, I could tell that no one else in the room had and they'll need input from the people on the ground actively feeding America. JD brought up one of my favorite words: "stewardship." No one is a better steward of the land than those living and working on it.

Another area of agreement that JD brought up regarding health was how huge declines in the physical health of our youth prevent so many from even joining the military at present. Our country's biggest potential treasure is always the upcoming generation, and for us to be strong physically and intellectually competitive as a nation, we have to be healthy.

In the end, it was easy to see the common ground in the room. Also, while there was no time to specifically bring wildfire management up as I'd hoped, I do have a way to get all that information where it needs to go now. Rest assured, if you're a firefighter or landowner who has reached out to me, your stories are going where they need to go.

I couldn't help but note how abruptly Usha Vance's life has changed. JD himself mentioned how now he can't move without "18 Secret Service agents" around him. Last few times we saw him, he was just walking around the room freely, a senator hanging out for pictures, getting coffee ...

I added some fun photos above. The red pill containers as centerpieces were cute. One millionaire (or maybe billionaire?) asked me why there was nothing in the capsules. I didn't know whether to be more worried about why she was _hoping_ for something in the capsules - or why no one there knew what being red-pilled meant! The Sackses brought back their famous Trump claw machine. Thanks to Vivien's trips to the arcade, Solomon is a skilled expert and we got all the goodies! Finally, as there was a bowling lane in the venue, they'd replaced the usual balls with specially made Trump Vance ones. So there Solomon and I went, traipsing across LAX headed home with sparkly red and shiny blue bowling balls ...

The event raised $3.5 million. Internal polling is _very_ positive, by the way.

**OREGON CONSERVATIVE CAUCUS.
**
Website: [Oregon Conservative Caucus | Nonprofit](https://sptr.eocampaign1.com/f/a/bCc5SSD4mwkXwObIWtp-ow~~/AAAHUQA~/RgRowy82P0UgMTBkMjVlY2NhYmFkMjM1YjI1NzNkMzM1Y2JhMTI3N2ZEKWh0dHBzOi8vd3d3Lm9yZWdvbmNvbnNlcnZhdGl2ZWNhdWN1cy5jb20vVwVzcGNldUIKZtc2quBmJr8pAFIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAX2M~)

We're methodically building our membership out county by county. Our educational perks are beginning this month. I can't wait to see the army we'll have in action on the ground to start affecting Oregon elections next year. With our ground game, we CAN flip this state red.

**OTHER OREGON EVENTS.
**
Last month, Patty Trost, Keith Jones, Suzan Jones and I - the Precinct Committee People (PCPs) representing the Burnt River area of Baker County - held a townhall in Hereford to be able to visit with our Republican neighbors face to face. It's hard to find ways to do that! We even had PCPs from Malheur County come, which was wonderful! I had to laugh, though. One human testament to the Dunning-Kruger effect, who orchestrated a failed coup last election by running his wife and others who lived nowhere near our area against us, had the nerve to show up. Real conservatives don't fight AGAINST local representation or instigate constant attacks against the people most willing to volunteer. My advice: bypass anyone like him and focus on ways to be effective.

In October, I'll be speaking at the Oregon Republican Women's meeting in Salem. I'm very much looking forward to it.

Over & out,

I’ve got to be completely honest: Kids that grow up the way I did do not become Senators.

I’m the son of a single mom. Between me and my three sisters, we could barely make ends meet.

name: Yassamin Ansari
subject: Why GOTV matters so much
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY YASSAMIN ANSARI FOR CONGRESS
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/yassaminansari_em?refcode=wrpr_hdr [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/yassaminansari_em?refcode=wrpr_hdr] Hey Peter, I know a lot of us are starting to feel tense with the election less than two months away. With so much hanging in the balance, that’s natural. It would be catastrophic to lose the White House to Donald Trump and to lose the Senate to the extremist GOP. In my experience, the best thing to do with all of our nervous energy right now is to channel it into meaningful action. And the number one way we can make a difference in this critical election is by getting out the vote. Our extremist MAGA opponents want us to believe we are powerless, Peter, but nothing could be farther from the truth. When ordinary people stand up, speak out, and vote for the things we believe in, we win. That’s why our GOTV efforts are so pivotal. Our district has one of the lowest voter turnout rates in the nation. There’s a massive group of people in our district who aren’t making their voices heard. In a battleground state like Arizona — which could decide the race for the White House and for both houses of Congress — reaching these voters could make all the difference. We don’t have much time to do that. The voter registration deadline in Arizona is October 7th — less than a month away. We need your support to continue registering and mobilizing as many people as possible, to ensure everyone in our community has a voice in our future. I’m facing a MAGA opponent of my own right here in California’s 25th, and I need all the support I can get to keep our seat blue and continue the fight for progress in the halls of Congress. = | | = The fight for reproductive rights, economic progress, and our democracy itself isn’t one we can take lightly. Donald Trump’s Project 2025 outlines just how dangerous he and his ideas would be to the very fabric of our country, targeting our fundamental rights and values at every corner. It’s going to take all of us to ensure a Democratic victory this November, up and down the ballot, including here in CA-25. = If you've stored your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will process immediately. | = | = | = | = | = | = — Raul | | | ---|---|--- = The son of hardworking farmworkers, Dr. Ruiz grew up in Coachella, CA and learned at an early age that the key to attaining the American Dream is hard work and a great education. In the summer of 1990, Raul walked in the desert heat from business to business in the Coachella Valley asking them to invest in their community by contributing to his education. With each investment for college, he made a promise to come back home and serve his community as a physician. In 2012, he decided to take his service to the community to the next level by running for Congress. Dr. Ruiz needs our help to continue fighting for us in Congress and to flip the House blue this November.** | = = PAID FOR BY DR. | Peter,

We've known all year that the race for Congress in Maryland's Sixth District was going to be one of the most important election battles in the country. **[Last week, Fox News named our race one of the five most pivotal battles that will decide control of the House.](https://mdpetitions.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=2433afe998&e=5a45ee1154)**

Winning this race won't be easy, though. April Delaney may not actually live in the district, but she's a multimillionaire with ultra-wealthy friends and donors from out of state. And they're flooding the district with new ads attacking Neil and lying about his record and accomplishments. And the Harris campaign has committed to spending $25 million on crucial down-ballot races, including Maryland's Sixth.

We have been within the margin of error, or tied, in polls with Delaney before. We have never been in the lead, until now. A few weeks ago we were down two points. Now we're up two! ## Exciting News – Americans for Prosperity Endorses Our Campaign!

Dear Friends,

I’m thrilled to announce that Americans for Prosperity (AfP) has officially endorsed our campaign once again! Their support was a game-changer in 2022, helping us get the word out, connect with voters, and drive our message home. AfP’s grassroots efforts—knocking on doors, making phone calls, and engaging directly with Alaskans—made a real difference, and I couldn’t be more excited to have them back on board for this race.

This endorsement is a big deal, and AfP’s commitment to free-market principles and limited government aligns perfectly with the values we’re fighting for in Alaska. As we head into the next phase of this campaign, their support will be crucial in helping us reach even more voters and build the momentum we need to win.

[](https://alaskansfornickbegich.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8aeb8c45837a089b0eee9add8&id=9c3e8d82fb&e=6679001ba0)

AfP is also actively looking for people to join their efforts as paid canvassers. If you’re interested in working directly with AfP to help spread our message across Alaska, please contact AfP Alaska for more details. This is a great opportunity to make a real impact and be part of the team.

Thank you for your continued support. Together, with the backing of organizations like AfP and grassroots supporters like you, we’ll keep fighting for a better future for Alaska.

**Thank you, from the bottom of my heart, for standing with us.** Let’s keep this momentum going and take back Alaska’s seat in Congress!

Together, we can ensure a prosperous future for all Alaskans.

**America First, Fighting for Alaska!**

Onward to victory,

Nick Begich
Candidate for U.S. Congress
\---

P.S. If you haven’t already, please consider volunteering or donating to our campaign. Every bit of help makes a huge difference in ensuring that Alaskans have the representation they deserve. Visit [our website](https://alaskansfornickbegich.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8aeb8c45837a089b0eee9add8&id=25ea3d6252&e=6679001ba0) to get involved!

To honor his lifelong dedication to education and philanthropy, we ask that memorial contributions be made to a college fund for his beloved daughters, Sophie (9) and Oliva (5). * **TOP NEWS**

**" Hurricane Francine landfall timeline: Here's when and where,"** Houston Chronicle's **Roberto Villalpando** and **Justin Ballard** -- "Tropical Storm Francine, [churning through the western Gulf of Mexico](https://substack.com/redirect/0e460eeb-9040-4a18-8dac-f882e0d4835b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) toward the Louisiana coast this week, was expected to intensify into a hurricane on Tuesday, National Hurricane Center forecasters said.

They warned that the storm could produce life-threatening storm surges before making landfall Wednesday in southern Louisiana, possibly as a Category 2 hurricane, which pack winds as strong as 110 mph. [The hurricane center](https://substack.com/redirect/ea463148-1eef-424b-821a-e48f1e29708b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) said that any storm preparations being made [along the Louisiana coast](https://substack.com/redirect/aaa569c8-3ed5-44f9-a101-db9dff126dca?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) need to be completed by the end of the day.

Radar imagery on Monday showed signs of a developing eye wall, indicating that Francine could strengthen into a hurricane soon, forecasters with the National Weather Service office overseeing Southeast Texas said.
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $7/mo](https://substack.com/redirect/5ac6144a-1d27-482a-9bbc-33cd094cd67f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
As of 7 a.m. Tuesday, the [rotating center of the tropical storm](https://substack.com/redirect/b1628924-750b-49ad-b199-e79087e51104?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) was about 125 miles southeast of the mouth of the Rio Grande and about 395 miles south of Cameron, Louisiana. Francine was packing maximum sustained winds of 65 mph and was moving north at 5 mph.

The National Weather Service placed the Louisiana coast from Sabine Pass at the Texas border eastward to Grand Isle under a [hurricane warning](https://substack.com/redirect/b1628924-750b-49ad-b199-e79087e51104?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). The warning is typically issued 36 hours before the first occurrence of tropical storm-force winds or conditions that make outside preparations difficult or dangerous, the weather service said, adding that "preparations to protect life and property should be rushed to completion."

A [storm surge warning](https://substack.com/redirect/b1628924-750b-49ad-b199-e79087e51104?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) was in effect for the U.S. Gulf Coast, from east of High Island in Texas to the mouth of the Mississippi River. Surge heights of 4 to 7 feet and 5 to 10 feet were possible, forecasters said. A warning means the affected area faces a life-threatening threat of rising water moving inland from the coastline in the next 36 hours, according to the weather service.
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $70/yr](https://substack.com/redirect/5ac6144a-1d27-482a-9bbc-33cd094cd67f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Meanwhile, a [tropical storm warning](https://substack.com/redirect/b1628924-750b-49ad-b199-e79087e51104?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) was in effect in Louisiana from Morgan City to the mouth of the Pearl River (border with Mississippi), and in Texas from High Island to Sabine Pass as well as from the Rio Grande to Port Mansfield. A warning means that tropical storm conditions are expected within 36 hours.

As Houston holds its breath, the center of [Tropical Storm Francine was moving northwest](https://substack.com/redirect/588c0452-5f10-4c7d-b450-b7aed3ca9030?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) early Tuesday off the east coast of northern Mexico. The storm is expected to speed up and turn northeast later on Tuesday.

"On the forecast track, Francine is anticipated to be just offshore of the coasts of northeastern Mexico and southern Texas through today, and make landfall in Louisiana on Wednesday," the National Hurricane Center said in its Tuesday forecast.

More intensification is likely to occur Tuesday and Wednesday as Francine spends more time absorbing heat energy from the especially warm waters in the western Gulf of Mexico. Forecasters said the storm could become a strong Category 1 or a Category 2 hurricane, with maximum sustained winds of 85 to 100 mph, before it makes its final landfall in south-central Louisiana.

Tropical storm-force winds, which can range from 40 to 70 mph, extend outward up to 140 miles from Francine's rotating center, forecasters said.

In a Tuesday morning briefing, the weather service office overseeing the Houston and Galveston areas said "Francine has been disorganized overnight; however, it is expected to become better organized and strengthen into a hurricane today."

"Coastal counties along the upper Texas coast could potentially be impacted with strong winds and coastal flooding along with locally heavy rainfall," forecasters said, adding that landfall was still expected in Louisiana." #TeamLizzie has been out and about across the district again this week. Our office is abuzz, and we were excited to kick off our fall postcard-writing campaign and our block walks of volunteers talking with voters about the election that’s just eight weeks away.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe240910wu?refcode=lpfe240910wu [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe240910wu?refcode=lpfe240910wu]
More endorsements! Lizzie earned the endorsements of so many organizations and people we trust during the primary, and we are so proud to share that two more organizations have endorsed Lizzie this week: The Alliance for Retired Americans and the Brady PAC!
https://www.lizziefletcher.com/endorsements-2024/ [https://www.lizziefletcher.com/endorsements-2024/] https://www.lizziefletcher.com/endorsements-2024/ [https://www.lizziefletcher.com/endorsements-2024/]
The Alliance for Retired Americans represents over 4.4 million retirees and older Americans, including over 157,000 Texans. This endorsement recognizes Lizzie’s commitment to ensuring that all Americans can retire securely and confidently, including her efforts to protect and strengthen Medicare and Social Security and lower prescription costs for seniors.
Lizzie’s endorsement from the Brady PAC is a testament to her unwavering commitment to preventing gun violence in our communities. During her time in Congress, Lizzie has demonstrated strong leadership and dedication in championing common sense gun safety measures—including helping pass the first new gun-safety law in decades—that protect our communities and save lives.
As always, there are plenty of ways to get involved this week:
1. Join us for a phone bank this Wednesday, September 11 [https://www.mobilize.us/fletcherforcongress/event/678056/] , as we call our neighbors and help them make plans to vote.
https://www.mobilize.us/fletcherforcongress/ [https://www.mobilize.us/fletcherforcongress/]
2. Sign up for our postcard-writing party this Thursday, September 12! [https://www.mobilize.us/fletcherforcongress/event/678043/] Join for coffee and conversation while writing postcards during the shift from 10 a.m. to noon or BYOB in the early evening during the shift from 6 to 8 p.m.
https://www.mobilize.us/fletcherforcongress/ [https://www.mobilize.us/fletcherforcongress/]
3. And if you want to talk to our neighbors about voting face to face, join us for a block walk this Saturday, September 14. [https://www.mobilize.us/fletcherforcongress/event/678074/]
https://www.mobilize.us/fletcherforcongress/ [https://www.mobilize.us/fletcherforcongress/]
Action Item You Can Do Right Now:
As you may have seen, our state removed over 1 million Texans from our voter rolls in a purge stemming from the Texas Legislature’s sweeping package of voting restrictions, disproportionately impacting voters of color and voters with disabilities. Since his inauguration in January 2022, Jason has been focused on fighting violent crime and improving public safety, strengthening economic growth, combatting the deadly impact of opioids and fentanyl, and protecting Virginians from corporate misconduct. He's been fearless in standing up for the rule of law by challenging the Biden-Harris Administration whenever it tries to use lawfare to advance its radical agenda, whether it's failing to secure the border or advancing its extreme green agenda. name: Nella
subject: Nella’s Tribute to her Cherished Aunt Thelma Domenici
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Nella for Senate
body:
Thelma Domenici, age 96 passed on Sunday at her home | | | | | [](https://nellaforsenate.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6ac79b36261163c3706eb25b8&id=9b38c60c8a&e=780129cd82)
---
| **Nella’s Tribute to her Cherished Aunt Thelma Domenici** _Thelma Domenici, age 96 passed on Sunday at her home_
---
| **Albuquerque, NM –** “I watched my Aunt Thelma trailblaze in the many paths of her life. She was a 'first' in so many of her professional pursuits and accomplishments. She inspired me and many others to dare to trailblaze, too.
When she wasn’t working, Aunt Thelma was celebrating life—she loved to entertain, especially cooking delicious Italian family recipes. She collected friendships. When Thelma knew you, she really knew you in a deep and meaningful way.
She also collected art and artists; she understood their artistic languages. Aunt Thelma read all of Tony Hillerman’s books and spent many evenings with him and other authors. She appreciated New Mexico’s natural beauty. She hiked our highest peaks and nurtured a robust garden of herbs, vegetables, and flowers.
Aunt Thelma lived and breathed her Catholic beliefs in every thought and deed. She prayed every day. Her faith gave her purpose, direction, and peace. She taught me by example the importance of living a purposeful life.
She was so pleased that I am running for the United States Senate. It meant so much to me that she was my honorary chair for Women for Nella.
Aunt Thelma was overflowing with love for her family, friends, and community.”
[The Albuquerque Journal: The life of Thelma Domenici](https://nellaforsenate.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6ac79b36261163c3706eb25b8&id=bc1ddd883d&e=780129cd82)
**Funeral Mass will be held at 10 a.m. on September 21, 2024 at Our Lady of the Annunciation Catholic Church, 2621 Vermont St NE, Albuquerque, NM 87110.** ###

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92564134/497540550/-1787004069?refcode=header&amount=25&&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS8xMDAzNTUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNmNiODZmNmEtYzM2Zi1lZjExLTk5MWEtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=PXYXYHpGrwZTcQFdTHaKbtob29X2mIxXC7VMTQAQASM=) | **Former President Donald Trump is doubling down on dangerous rhetoric.** He recently issued a warning that he would attempt to imprison anyone involved in “unscrupulous behavior” or who “cheated” during the 2024 election results. name: Dr. Kristin Hook
subject: This Is the Job!
body:
| | | | | [](https://drkristinhook.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fd888d2bb4a2d4cad917af4b9&id=e27aba3ac5&e=395a33a3d2)
---
| _**Wowee**_**is this campaign moving fast and getting busier than ever!**
After recovering from COVID, I got back out there to deliver some yard signs and to hit the pavement to knock more doors and talk to voters.
As a first-time candidate, not to mention someone who prides themselves in _NOT_ being a politician, I’ve gotta say it is pretty surreal to see my name in people’s yards!
**I am SO HONORED to have your support!**
---
| _If you’re in district and want your own yard flair, fill in this_[ _yard sign request form here_](https://drkristinhook.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fd888d2bb4a2d4cad917af4b9&id=515ae6e4e8&e=395a33a3d2) _._
---
| I’m also incredibly grateful to all of the folks who have been organizing and helping us reach the voters in our district by block-walking with me and other candidates!
Like David – an 86 year old Air Force veteran who lives in TX-21 and came out to help this past week.Like me, David is ready to #FLIPCHIP andwas game to go off-list to talk to _everyone_ outside, including the one house with a Trump sign. :-)
---
| One of the recurring themes I heard this week, is how important it is to our district that their representative is willingto hear them out and understand their perspective.
This is precisely why I am running!Like me, so many folks do not feel represented.Chip Roy has done nothing but sow division, and he has made it clear that he is not here to represent all of us, just those who are as extreme in their viewpoints as he is.
In this respect, I could not be a more different than my opponent.**No matter what your politics are,****I will always fight for you and your family.**
I know I’m a different candidate when the conservative man out walking his dog stopped to chat with me, shook my hand, and thanked me for being out in the neighborhood. “It really shows your character” he told me.
I know I’m a different candidate when a guy outside pushing his kid in a stroller said _“You’re running for Congress?!__What are you doing here_ _talking to me on my street?”_
I looked him straight in the eyes and said: **THIS IS THE JOB!**
The incredible people in our district deserve a leader who is OF THE PEOPLE, and I can’t wait to change that in our district when I’m elected!
---

body:
Kamala Harris and I are fighting side-by-side to keep Nevada blue.
| | |
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92564442/497541759/1399008008?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&amount=5&refcode=jtk4718-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwM2YzNzhlNC1jNDZmLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=GUL1qMrwaBkbqBYQQGEKQl7kg0bD9KGqDrWAAYHZM8U=)
Here's the hard truth, team: We won't have a shot at defending Democratic control of the Senate _or_ sending Kamala Harris to the White House if we don't keep battleground Nevada blue.

**That's why Kamala Harris and I are standing side-by-side in the fight of our lives to win this pivotal battleground state – but we cannot do it without the grassroots support of folks like you.**
**[So today, I'm humbly asking: Will you rush $5 or more now to my campaign today to help keep Nevada blue?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92564443/497541760/1399008008?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&amount=5&refcode=jtk4718-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwM2YzNzhlNC1jNDZmLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=GUL1qMrwaBkbqBYQQGEKQl7kg0bD9KGqDrWAAYHZM8U=)**
| | [Donate $5](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/92564444/497541761/1399008008?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&amount=5&refcode=jtk4718-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwM2YzNzhlNC1jNDZmLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=GUL1qMrwaBkbqBYQQGEKQl7kg0bD9KGqDrWAAYHZM8U=)
---
Here's where things stand right now:**Experts are calling Nevada one of the few true toss-up states in the entire country. In fact,_The Cook Political Report_ called Nevada the "most perilous" battleground for Democrats.**

Donald Trump and his MAGA allies in the Senate know it, too. **At his latest rally here in Nevada, Trump told his base: "If we win Nevada, we're going to win the whole thing."**

That's why dark money groups like the Koch network are pouring****_tens of millions of dollars_ into Nevada to flip it red. Now, my campaign is getting pummeled on the airwaves, and expert polling shows me statistically TIED with my extreme, Trump-backed MAGA opponent.

Peter,
At the end of August, Kirsten had her first debate against her Republican opponent. She put him on the defensive, making him answer for abandoning the border, voting against reproductive rights, and being part of an extremist Christian nationalist organization.
Winning the debate has given Kirsten some crucial momentum heading into September. With less than a month until ballots drop, every day counts.
Below are recent photos of Kirsten on the campaign trail. But before you check them out, we have to ask: Can you rush a donation to support our campaign now so we don’t get outspent by our opponent’s corporate donors? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/engel2024_email?refcode=X_091024_Recap_act]

Kirsten’s husband and brother joined her at the 37th Saguaro National Park Labor Day race! Now, she’s turning her energy towards an even bigger finish line: Election Day.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/engel2024_email?refcode=X_091024_Recap_act [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/engel2024_email?refcode=X_091024_Recap_act]
Kirsten addressed a group of engaged voters at a Green Valley Chamber Candidate Event and then swung by the Green Valley Democratic Headquarters to thank them for their hard work. Together, we can ensure that our community continues to thrive and grow.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/engel2024_email?refcode=X_091024_Recap_act [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/engel2024_email?refcode=X_091024_Recap_act]
We had an incredible day in Sierra Vista! Kirsten toured the Canyon Vista Medical Center and had meaningful conversations with many community stakeholders, including Theresa Walsh, Sheriff Dannels, CEO Shaun Phillips, and Dr. Randy Groth. Grateful for the insights shared about local healthcare and public safety.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/engel2024_email?refcode=X_091024_Recap_act [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/engel2024_email?refcode=X_091024_Recap_act]
Kirsten had a great lunch with Sierra Vista Mayor Clea McCaa II at the Landmark Café. They discussed the pressing issues facing our communities — from boosting local economies to ensuring our schools and infrastructure get the support they need.
In 2022, this race was decided by 1%.
This election is going to come down to a handful of votes. We have less than two months to reach those swing voters with Kirsten’s message and mobilize them to the polls.
We can do it, but it’s going to take all of us.
At the end of September, we have a huge quarterly fundraising deadline. Will you help us hit our goal and take on the out-of-state money coming into AZ-06 by chipping in now? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/engel2024_email?refcode=X_091024_Recap_act]

Team Engel

New reporting from USA Today indicates that Donald Trump’s campaign believes it has a real chance this November at winning Virginia’s prized 13 Electoral College votes.
According to the report, his optimism is based in reality:
“Trump’s team has its reasons to be optimistic — or at least reasons to suggest it should be in Virginia. In the last statewide election, voters picked Republican Glenn Youngkin, a relative newcomer to politics, as their governor over a popular Democrat with deep roots in the party.” —USA Today, September 2024
While some political pundits are giving Kamala Harris the edge in the upcoming election, Trump is looking to replicate Youngkin’s 2021 ‘surprise’ win with a victory of his own in 2024.
And so is Republican Senate candidate Hung Cao — the candidate running to unseat Tim Kaine in November.
With so much on the line this year, we can’t afford to leave ANYTHING to chance. So we’re asking:
Will you donate $20 or more to ensure Tim Kaine has the resources he needs to organize a massive Democratic turnout this November? Your contribution will go directly to ensuring Virginia stays in the blue column for the White House AND the Senate. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024]

# Volunteer Newsletter Kickoff: Let’s Do This Again!
September 10th, 2024
---
|
---
|
Hello Team Suozzi!
As November approaches, we are _**back**_ in the full campaign swing! We know what it takes to win an election from our historic victory in February, so we are calling on you again to bring your full energy. Team Suozzi is a strong community, and together, we can reelect Congressman Suozzi.
If you are looking for ways to help out, we are opening our campaign offices over the next 2 weekends and we would love to have you there! We have also been knocking doors and will start phone banking soon. Below, we’ve included all the information you need to get started.
We are excited about the campaign, and know that your participation in canvassing can make a huge difference! Looking forward to seeing you all out there, and once again electing the right man to Congress - let’s fix this!
Best,Sara Castelli
---
|
---
|
# Office Openings
---
| We are excited to announce and invite you all to our campaign office openings! Our team is ready to hit the ground running and we hope you are too. This will not be an easy race to win so join us at our office openings to make a difference and help get the vote out.

| Massachusetts Trump 2024 Chairman Joins MassGOP in Criticizing Bidenomics and Immigration Crisis, Urges a Return to Republican Leadership
---
---
| Boston, MA- Under the Biden-Harris Administration, both the United States and the Commonwealth of Massachusetts have faced skyrocketing inflation and an unchecked immigration crisis. The world is undeniably more dangerous than it was just four years ago. If Vice President Harris assumes the presidency, Americans can expect a continuation of the current administration's policies, but with an even more progressive and harmful agenda for both the nation and the Commonwealth.
Sheriff Tom Hodgson, Chairman of the Massachusetts Trump 2024 Campaign, commented on the state of the race, stating, "What Americans need is a decisive break from Bidenomics, which has fueled inflation while keeping wages stagnant. Republicans offer a stronger path forward--tax cuts, deregulation, and an economic environment where young people can afford homes and build their futures."
"America needs a robust border--something the Biden-Harris Administration has allowed to deteriorate--leaving states like Massachusetts grappling with a costly migrant crisis which is set to cost taxpayers billions and will likely result in higher taxes or cuts to essential services for Massachusetts residents," Hodgson continued.
"America needs leadership that will stand firm on the global stage. Under Republican leadership, Americans trusted their president to make strong, decisive foreign policy decisions. Today, we are left uncertain about who is truly in control of our country's future," said Hodgson.
Setting aside partisan political posturing, it's clear that under Republican leadership, America was in a stronger position than it is today. We must move away from the divisive 'us versus them' mentality and the class warfare that Democrats at both the national and state levels continue to push. It's time for the nation to come together and vote for policies that drive American prosperity, not the divisive and misleading rhetoric that has left the country poorer, weaker, and more divided than ever," Hodgson concluded.

The Missouri Supreme Court just confirmed that the initiative to restore reproductive freedom in Missouri will officially appear on the November ballot.
I want to explain more about what happened and how this decision impacts our U.S. Senate race.
Last Friday night, Judge Limbaugh (of the powerful Limbaugh political family) ruled in favor of Josh Hawley's insider allies in a last-minute effort to REMOVE Missouri's abortion rights initiative from the November ballot. It was an unprecedented attack on our freedoms and our ability to even participate directly in Missouri's democracy.
But their efforts just failed. The Supreme Court has confirmed abortion will indeed be on the ballot in Missouri this November.
Now let's talk about how this connects to our U.S. Senate race.
Since 2022, voters in red and purple states across the country -- like Michigan, Kansas, Kentucky, and Ohio -- have overwhelmingly approved measures to secure abortion rights. And with Missourians' streak of approving pro-freedom measures -- like raising the minimum wage, expanding Medicaid, and legalizing weed all by huge margins since 2018 -- we know our state has what it takes to restore abortion access and protect reproductive rights this year.
Josh Hawley has the most extreme record on abortion, birth control, and IVF of ANY member of the U.S. Senate. He's spent his entire career crusading against the freedom for everyday people to make decisions about how to live their own lives and build their own families.
And he's even cosponsored a national abortion ban that would overturn the will of the voters here in Missouri and every other state in America.
Missouri's election is going to be about freedom -- and it's going to cut across party and all the ways that politicians like Josh Hawley have tried to use to divide us. This November we're going to defeat this abortion ban in Missouri, and we're going to secure our freedoms nationwide.
That's why I'm coming to you directly to ask:
Can I count on you to chip in whatever you can to my campaign right now so we can build on this historic momentum, defeat Josh Hawley, and restore reproductive rights nationwide this November?

This election is our one and only chance to replace Josh Hawley and take back power for everyday Missourians -- and we absolutely cannot afford to waste it.
I couldn't do it without you.
Now let's get this done. From here on, it's up to us. We're taking our power back in November.

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Last week, Israeli soldiers shot and killed 26-year-old American
demonstrator Ayşenur Eygi while she was peacefully protesting the illegal
occupation of the West Bank.

Another peace activist who witnessed Ayşenur’s murder said: “Americans are
now being shot with American weapons by the Israeli army.” They
volunteered with the same human rights group that another American, Rachel
Corrie, was part of in 2002 when an Israeli soldier crushed her to death
with a bulldozer as she tried to block it from demolishing Palestinian
homes. The U.S. government never investigated Rachel’s murder.

President Biden said in February that “If you kill an American, we will
respond.” But the Israeli military has killed multiple American citizens
during his administration, and the response continues to involve asking
Israeli officials to investigate their own crimes, while supplying weapons
and funding for the murders. This is like calling for the fox to guard the
henhouse.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/signup/petition_20240910_justice_for_aysenur_eygi/?source=em20240910-35981&t=1002&akid=35981%2E1203867%2ErJl18M ]Together, let’s join the family of Ayşenur Eygi in demanding the Biden
administration order an immediate independent investigation into Ayşenur’s
murder and stop letting Israeli soldiers murder Americans with impunity.
Add your name now >>

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/signup/petition_20240910_justice_for_aysenur_eygi/?source=em20240910-35981&t=1003&akid=35981%2E1203867%2ErJl18M ]Take Action

Ayşenur recently graduated from the University of Washington, where she
participated in the solidarity encampments against the genocide in Gaza.
Weeks before Ayşenur’s murder, Israeli forces shot American teacher Amado
Sison and threw stun grenades at Americans protesting illegal Israeli
settlements in the West Bank.

The activist with Ayşenur said: “If there had been a lot of retaliation
after Amado was shot, she would still be alive. She died because the
American government did not do anything to the Israeli army. They didn’t
even tell the Israeli army to stop shooting American citizens.”

In 2022, Israeli soldiers killed 78-year-old Palestinian-American Omar
Assad during a brutal arrest. Also in 2022, Israeli forces murdered
beloved Palestinian-American journalist Shireen Abu Akleh in the West Bank
while she was covering an Israeli military raid on a refugee camp. Shireen
was clearly identified as a journalist by her blue vest that read “PRESS.”
The U.S. government refused to open an independent investigation, though I
pushed Congress and the White House alongside Shireen’s family. Her
family, and Rachel Corrie’s family, are still waiting for accountability
from the U.S. and Israeli governments. Human rights groups note that
Israel clears its soldiers of wrongdoing in 99% of cases.

The Israeli government is emboldened to continue acting with impunity, as
the United States continues to arm its genocide against the Palestinian
people. Over the past 11 months, Israel’s government has killed more than
40,000 Palestinians in Gaza and at least 623 Palestinians in the West
Bank. Israel also imprisoned more than 10,000 West Bank Palestinians,

Friends,

Here are the cold hard facts: Trump and the Republicans raised taxes here on Long Island. And they did it out of spite as a part of a political stunt.
State and local tax ( SALT) deductions save families across Suffolk County an average of $10,000 per year, and this next election will determine whether you see that money again – or it's gone for good.
Nick LaLota constantly talks about how he's trying to get SALT deductions back, but he just can't get it done. Why? Because Republicans are never, ever going to restore the SALT tax deduction.
Nick LaLota knows it, and so should you.

In fact, Republican leadership has already promised to make the removal of SALT tax deductions permanent if they get back into power. It's right there in black and white. So why should you believe lying Nick Lalota? He's a follower, not a leader.

But, if you vote for John Avlon for Congress and Democrats take back the house, you will get back that state and local-tax deduction.
Why? Because all the Trump tax cuts are set to expire in 2025, and if Democrats take the house with Hakeem Jeffries as speaker, you'll get that money back.
What would you do with $10,000 extra a year? That's a down payment on a home. That's much needed breathing room for you and your family. And if you're raising kids, we'll work to expand the Child Tax Credit and put an average of $6,600 in your pocket for a family.

So this election, vote with your hopes and not your fears. Vote to lower the cost of living and increase the quality of life.
Nick LaLota's empty promises just keep rubbing SALT in our wounds. John Avlon will get that money back. Because he'll fight for Suffolk County families every day.

Nick LaLota constantly talks about how he's trying to get SALT deductions back, but he just can't get it done. Why? Because Republicans are never, ever going to restore the SALT tax deduction. Nick LaLota knows it, and so should you. In fact, Republican leadership has already promised to make the removal of SALT tax deductions permanent if they get back into power. It's right there in black and white. So why should you believe lying Nick Lalota? He's a follower, not a leader. But, if you vote for John Avlon for Congress and Democrats take back the house, you will get back that state and local-tax deduction. Why? Because all the Trump tax cuts are set to expire in 2025, and if Democrats take the house with Hakeem Jeffries as speaker, you'll get that money back. What would you do with $10,000 extra a year? That's a down payment on a home. That's much needed breathing room for you and your family. And if you're raising kids, we'll work to expand the Child Tax Credit and put an average of $6,600 in your pocket for a family. So this election, vote with your hopes and not your fears. Vote to lower the cost of living and increase the quality of life. Nick LaLota's empty promises just keep rubbing SALT in our wounds. John Avlon will get that money back. | **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

name: Ben Steinhoff
subject: Weekly Wrap-up
body:
It’s been an insane week— | | | | Ben Steinhoff |
---|---
|
## Ben’s weekly wrap-up
---
---
Hey everyone! It has been an insane week in all senses of the word. Friday, I joined the Carroll University Progressives at their annual Involvement Fair table to encourage incoming freshmen to get registered to vote and involved in their local parties. I met so many new students, and new voters that are excited to elect Democrats up and down the ballot. The support of our youth will be critical to our win this November. I also attended the campaign launch party for Kevin Reilly, the amazing candidate for the 82nd Assembly district on September 5th at the Dreams Event & Wellness Center. I mingled with other great candidates, connected with our neighbors, and shared excitement for the new legislative maps that give us an opportunity to start flipping seats in the State Assembly. I also had the opportunity to attend Laborfest over the long holiday weekend. I had an amazing time being able to speak with so many union members and union heads on Monday. We were able to walk in the Laborfest**** parade with the Sheet metal workers Local 18 and learn a little bit more about their trade and why they support their trade union. We marched to the Summerfest grounds where we were able to hear from Governor Evers, Rep. Gwen Moore, Sen. Tammy Baldwin, and Governor Tim Walz! After Governor Walz’s great speech we had the opportunity to speak with him about the parallels in our congressional races where Tim told me some exciting news about how him and VP Harris will be seeing us a “few more times” this year and how they'll be “helping us out a lot” in our race. Little did I know 12 hours later their campaign would be committing 25 million dollars to down ballot candidates!!I also joined The Daily Beans podcast this week, a daily news podcast I've been listening to for years. I was featured in their “flip it blue” segment where we discussed everything from the makeup of the 5th all the way to why I'm running, which became a tearful moment the host Dr. Gill was not expecting. The 24 hours after I was featured on the podcast we had gained over 3,000 new followers and a large outpouring of donations! You can hear the full podcast here: [https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/we-dont-have-to-live-this-way-feat-ben-steinhoff-wi-5/id1473747182?i=1000668418379](https://engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=66e0d87f3bd8fb7de6008315&u=https%3A%2F%2Fpodcasts.apple.com%2Fus%2Fpodcast%2Fwe-dont-have-to-live-this-way-feat-ben-steinhoff-wi-5%2Fid1473747182%3Fi%3D1000668418379&w=64002ad52c8bd372efe2ab94&c=b_66e0d71acae29c1fc66826f7&l=en-US&s=3AMJaKhC_GgbvMC4vNCmtcGZz1Q%3D) Remember, this is a PEOPLE-POWERED campaign, and I truly could not do this without each and every one of you!We are getting closer to the looming November 5th day! Every day is going to matter. We can’t let ourselves sit back on November 6th and wonder what we could have done better. The best time for decisive action was yesterday, so the next best thing is today! If you can sign up for a canvassing shift, phone banking, events, and the ever important donation to your favorite candidates. It is about time we FLIP THE FIFTH!

Fellow American,

Why are you hearing from me?

**Well, I was raised in New Jersey. I love this state._And I love this country._**

[**I would like you to check out what Curtis Bashaw has to say, and if you agree with him, join me in supporting him in his bid for the US Senate.**](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=1c1fc303f3e641f994dc1fed5d3c9504&_e=xPKIXO8S3ovoLaoP0kLM2mM_938jAD8Iao4wVPxga2sNZxIShnNw_SAa1zGQqjxVAAEEwJHAwRZFWfwOCxWWUG0uYhL6WLK43LPFsCdhBmzwqbtA0zD6dEC_NJw3kx-UdPBLcl-T5-TD3wQ2je3rMMl_IQd9MNq19jn5cuX2uQf3KH35Z8lCd553yEwq-hvukhkbKPMjlEtLPqXcF0ZVpUOHFZ0ChIncqUcrq6_Gk4z3mvwNdow_gxGNJR9zIgp2VrQ_3zn87pSkXTBgAYkeVO7uyrnjIoJ3XiglnaaEZLLdce_Mxu85YwmKxAhNtUCcB9Wx2HWTINBX2FiKEwcvGGFpaNxXIeW34dXJmjjcMt-btzyBeeso1Fvx1bI4EMiWYOkX84O63g7JU1IovXcL1YMkzNDfU0iEu51Rpi3zfes%3D)

[** JOIN CURTIS BASHAW > **](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=1c1fc303f3e641f994dc1fed5d3c9504&_e=xPKIXO8S3ovoLaoP0kLM2mM_938jAD8Iao4wVPxga2sNZxIShnNw_SAa1zGQqjxVAAEEwJHAwRZFWfwOCxWWUG0uYhL6WLK43LPFsCdhBmzwqbtA0zD6dEC_NJw3kx-UdPBLcl-T5-TD3wQ2je3rMMl_IQd9MNq19jn5cuX2uQf3KH35Z8lCd553yEwq-hvukhkbKPMjlEtLPqXcF0ZVpUOHFZ0ChIncqUcrq6_Gk4z3mvwNdow_gxGNJR9zIgp2VrQ_3zn87pSkXTBgAYkeVKKq9aD9vs4kRP5sfIP3mEvcpI0PB6b4vT2HWbm9lWP6_sYROWCKb2p_oc37dOwqivuaXZXHAeN9bnIXPHUvZ0ZW3Sd2w5A4bgSGB9kLgeWNvlf8tT1tLHKfXSe9EL1gDokvE2h8Mym9itvTf94xn9c%3D)

I have been a known conservative in Hollywood throughout my career. It wasn’t always easy, but the latest from the bankrupt elites in my town really got to me.

After President Trump was shot, the only echo reverberating through my so-called “community” was a regret that the assassin failed to kill him. Weeks later, on a zoom call: White Dudes for Kamala. In a masterpiece of intolerance, in a breathtakingly short period of time, we learned what they are all about: _Hatred and Racism._ **Pathetic**.

I refuse to rail about the Democrats and what they have inflicted upon this country. We all know about their shortcomings, and we all know the kind of future we can bank on should they remain in power.

[**I believe Curtis Bashaw is the right kind of man to send to Washington to promote well-being in New Jersey and the United States at large. We can look to him to protect the Jersey Shore.**](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=1c1fc303f3e641f994dc1fed5d3c9504&_e=xPKIXO8S3ovoLaoP0kLM2mM_938jAD8Iao4wVPxga2sNZxIShnNw_SAa1zGQqjxVAAEEwJHAwRZFWfwOCxWWUG0uYhL6WLK43LPFsCdhBmzwqbtA0zD6dEC_NJw3kx-UdPBLcl-T5-TD3wQ2je3rMMl_IQd9MNq19jn5cuX2uQf3KH35Z8lCd553yEwq-hvukhkbKPMjlEtLPqXcF0ZVpUOHFZ0ChIncqUcrq6_Gk4z3mvwNdow_gxGNJR9zIgp2VrQ_3zn87pSkXTBgAYkeVNddNX09jFsGVdctA7uYUcebPWhKromxtSUdVxcv7Lre5eDH8W_5m7p3s0a-BTQ6n6KwUKBq7FepJqHBMI4VQpaXSRJ4XqxWOZV2RG7DRF2eXoVtkWQP6Y2c0mTe1VQn5YEa_YZbe8WFoIYSjQliBj8%3D)

Peter,

Last month, I welcomed my friend, U.S. House Speaker Mike Johnson, to New Mexico. During our time together, I discussed the urgent need to reform the Radiation Exposure Compensation Act program, which unfortunately lapsed in June.

As an [**original cosponsor**](http://links.yvetteherrell.com/u/click?_t=60a077210c21435397f83f8f2527f964&_m=ece436307fbd4416a28b8399021dc7b9&_e=E0JbTCSKFxA1BXkR2P_3tnHtZNKWn0ej-W6PWku14pECe8vbvvkFzxp2dv8HdL5J0TeLLU2IH4txu0BHhQ3YyinbgwM_zNZDITh_JhMtoXoWn6VtsJACgCf-y_H9Yof00dmMU-WqPS7oznXofGhpjDGVSCet69HzjF6BtN7pIROkDrOKbzEZM2Bvm5OS2hqTBNukeGk1n7FOyjkWR6SfD-6xsBv1Lb-10Kw4htzHWieMJUXUU9qnvwyWShGyMSwUNLutztYbJtNF6lX3bmVkUw%3D%3D) of the RECA Amendments Act of 2021, I understand how critical this program is to New Mexico and those who, through no fault of their own, have been exposed to radiation.

Whether it be the RECA Amendments Act legislation, which I previously cosponsored and fought for while in Congress, or the [**Uranium Miners and Workers Act**](http://links.yvetteherrell.com/u/click?_t=60a077210c21435397f83f8f2527f964&_m=ece436307fbd4416a28b8399021dc7b9&_e=E0JbTCSKFxA1BXkR2P_3tnHtZNKWn0ej-W6PWku14pFSNPGbUOnvcyAJeuhNk74inc3wseW9HhsQSHAX5xGixap0j23-64fQF9X0H5rQ_1DNS-eJE5wwg4Ue6wOM5YuVgnuLDodRqhQKaWT6j_XfS5AwFdunwPf-g04OT8zZSEPJCxgw0chE_QpkM744uJm12D6tfXZZ4uQnNzSfODTR8u-u60ueVQclBLfrqoePxxNS-OhtPnMTWkPfSwVytiqYPvLCI_KhuWOFA_2i4wxmQtBvFSmf8sJlIgIqcIdEYTJJojGzGmFqi9OizPVh_4z3), I support any effort to reform this vital program. That’s why I continue to underscore the urgency and need to act in my town hall events, roundtable meetings, and conversations with congressional leaders, including House Judiciary Committee Chairman Jim Jordan, whose legislative committee oversees RECA.

As the saying goes, we must not let the perfect be the enemy of the good. We need to take action now, as too many people are suffering and cannot afford to wait any longer.

Rep. Harriet Hageman, who represents one of the largest uranium mining states in the nation, recently penned an [**opinion piece**](http://links.yvetteherrell.com/u/click?_t=60a077210c21435397f83f8f2527f964&_m=ece436307fbd4416a28b8399021dc7b9&_e=E0JbTCSKFxA1BXkR2P_3tr08ZMVj5yv2TegsvJgQYu4n9qNoZF9Unp9oBvV8p2U6LV0XoNEORkjI5AaSuyBRCoLwMeEq70BbGi-m1pNWpGuXMhSdTOoyW3V7CoP9zEoikiZ6ZsU9NZwHnC6_QThDiuiyopmJaeWq4ocDUCsvf6XaUzjEgbQaL0jE5pju7VXfnWdlL72D1VlA-bhvrD7z7BkR4-QO_gA9hPkxe1t3bHpPt4qK55oG-AWpVnqVyhpCGncgD8jM0gHrzCygCrL9aso1ujOoF0EU9aPbi0PIPGA%3D) about why the Uranium Miners and Workers bill could break the logjam on Capitol Hill and bring relief for uranium miners, mill workers, ore haulers, and core drillers – while extending the underlying RECA program for an additional four years to allow for downwinder exposure victims to file claims as their symptoms manifest.

Know that I will continue working hard to finally bring about the long-overdue reforms our hardworking New Mexican miners, workers, and others deserve. They are worth our best efforts.

**Update on the RECA Efforts in Washington**
In addition to Rep. Hageman’s RECA bill, there are two other RECA-related efforts currently being considered in D.C.

First, Sen. Josh Hawley’s (R-Missouri) RECA bill passed the Senate in March. This bill is estimated to cost nearly $60-70B, and doesn’t have a direct “pay-for” (or how to cover the costs of the legislation). Because the bill lacks a pay-for, the House has not scheduled a vote, but the Senator continues to look for any moving legislative vehicle to force a vote on his RECA bill.

Secondly, Sen. Mike Lee (R-Utah) and Rep. Celeste Maloy (R-Utah) introduced a bill in April to reauthorize the RECA program for two years –without any reforms. As you know, reauthorizing the baseline program does very little to help the plight of our country’s uranium miners and workers.

**Overview of the Uranium Miners and Workers Act (H.R. 3497/S. 1681)**
Sen. Cynthia Lummis (R-Wyoming) and Rep. Harriet Hageman (R-Wyoming) introduced the Uranium Miners and Workers Act of 2023 (S. 1681/H.R. 3497) on May 18, 2023.

H.R. 349/ S. 1681 is the first stand-alone bill of its kind that focused on post-1971 uranium miners and workers. Moving the bill is a House play; it’s fiscally conservative and led by Rep. Harriet Hageman, who is not only a firebrand conservative who sits on the House Judiciary Committee (RECA’s jurisdiction) but is also highly respected by her fellow caucus members.

To date, the Hageman bill has 28 bipartisan co-sponsors, 9 of whom are members of the House Judiciary Committee. Thus, the top priority is getting H.R. 3497 onto the House Judiciary Committee markup agenda for a vote, after which Speaker Johnson can decide when to move forward on this issue and potentially use the Hageman bill as the vehicle for a broader RECA compromise bill.

If enacted, H.R. 3497/ S. 1681 would:

* Extend RECA program eligibility by seven years for post-1971 uranium miners and workers (from January 1, 1942, to December 31, 1978);
* Include renal cancer and chronic renal disease to the list of diseases miners and workers can file. Previously, only mill workers and ore transporters with renal cancer and chronic renal disease could file a RECA claim, but not miners;
* Add core drillers as a compensable occupation; and,
* Reauthorize the underlying RECA program for _four_ additional years to provide time for the post-1971 uranium miners and workers to receive the justice and medical benefits they deserve

Yvette Herrell

clean_body: Know that I will continue working hard to finally bring about the long-overdue reforms our hardworking New Mexican miners, workers, and others deserve. They are worth our best efforts. | Peter, Last month, I welcomed my friend, U.S. House Speaker Mike Johnson, to New Mexico. During our time together, I discussed the urgent need to reform the Radiation Exposure Compensation Act program, which unfortunately lapsed in June. As an of the RECA Amendments Act of 2021, I understand how critical this program is to New Mexico and those who, through no fault of their own, have been exposed to radiation. Whether it be the RECA Amendments Act legislation, which I previously cosponsored and fought for while in Congress, or the , I support any effort to reform this vital program. That’s why I continue to underscore the urgency and need to act in my town hall events, roundtable meetings, and conversations with congressional leaders, including House Judiciary Committee Chairman Jim Jordan, whose legislative committee oversees RECA. As the saying goes, we must not let the perfect be the enemy of the good. We need to take action now, as too many people are suffering and cannot afford to wait any longer. Rep. Harriet Hageman, who represents one of the largest uranium mining states in the nation, recently penned an about why the Uranium Miners and Workers bill could break the logjam on Capitol Hill and bring relief for uranium miners, mill workers, ore haulers, and core drillers – while extending the underlying RECA program for an additional four years to allow for downwinder exposure victims to file claims as their symptoms manifest. Know that I will continue working hard to finally bring about the long-overdue reforms our hardworking New Mexican miners, workers, and others deserve. They are worth our best efforts. Update on the RECA Efforts in Washington In addition to Rep. Hageman’s RECA bill, there are two other RECA-related efforts currently being considered in D.C. First, Sen. Josh Hawley’s (R-Missouri) RECA bill passed the Senate in March. This bill is estimated to cost nearly $60-70B, and doesn’t have a direct “pay-for” (or how to cover the costs of the legislation). Because the bill lacks a pay-for, the House has not scheduled a vote, but the Senator continues to look for any moving legislative vehicle to force a vote on his RECA bill. Secondly, Sen. Mike Lee (R-Utah) and Rep. Celeste Maloy (R-Utah) introduced a bill in April to reauthorize the RECA program for two years –without any reforms. As you know, reauthorizing the baseline program does very little to help the plight of our country’s uranium miners and workers. Overview of the Uranium Miners and Workers Act (H.R. 3497/S. 1681) Sen. Cynthia Lummis (R-Wyoming) and Rep. Harriet Hageman (R-Wyoming) introduced the Uranium Miners and Workers Act of 2023 (S. 1681/H.R. 3497) on May 18, 2023. H.R. 349/ S. 1681 is the first stand-alone bill of its kind that focused on post-1971 uranium miners and workers. Moving the bill is a House play; it’s fiscally conservative and led by Rep. Harriet Hageman, who is not only a firebrand conservative who sits on the House Judiciary Committee (RECA’s jurisdiction) but is also highly respected by her fellow caucus members. To date, the Hageman bill has 28 bipartisan co-sponsors, 9 of whom are members of the House Judiciary Committee. Thus, the top priority is getting H.R. 3497 onto the House Judiciary Committee markup agenda for a vote, after which Speaker Johnson can decide when to move forward on this issue and potentially use the Hageman bill as the vehicle for a broader RECA compromise bill. If enacted, H.R. 3497/ S. 1681 would: Extend RECA program eligibility by seven years for post-1971 uranium miners and workers (from January 1, 1942, to December 31, 1978); Include renal cancer and chronic renal disease to the list of diseases miners and workers can file. Previously, only mill workers and ore transporters with renal cancer and chronic renal disease could file a RECA claim, but not miners; Add core drillers as a compensable occupation; and, Reauthorize the underlying RECA program for four additional years to provide time for the post-1971 uranium miners and workers to receive the justice and medical benefits they deserve Yvette Herrell | Born and raised in New Mexico, Yvette Herrell served for 4 terms in the New Mexico House of Representatives. | | Friend, Back when you were growing up, you may remember lazy Saturdays at the library with a kind but stern librarian. She would fill your mind with classics like _Pat the Bunny_ and _The Little Engine That Could_. And eventually you got old enough to roam by yourself and discover adventures like the _Three Musketeers_ , _Treasure Island_ and _Charlotte’s Web_. But today, all that has changed. The president of the American Library Association (ALA) is a self-described “Marxist lesbian.” Radical librarians call _Adventure of Huckleberry Finn_ and _To Kill a Mockingbird_ “racist.” They’ve stripped Laura Ingalls Wilder’s name from a prestigious book award because of her “problematic” _Little House_ series. And they bring men in wearing full makeup, dresses, and high heels for “Drag Queen Story Hours” where books like these are read to children of all ages... A is for Activist. An ABC board book for “families who want their kids to grow up in a space that is unapologetic about activism, environmental justice, civil rights, LGBTQ rights, and everything else that activists believe in and fight for...”

| | For decades, the ultra-liberal Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation and George Soros’ Open Society have spent millions radicalizing the ALA. And as a result, a new generation of pink-haired, activist librarians have made it their mission to fill library shelves with anti-American, LGBTQ-friendly, and explicitly sexual content. Maybe you’ve noticed all the displays at your own library celebrating Pride Month or elevating “the environment” to a type of religion. The “Teen Zone” is filled with books like: _Rick_ about a cross-dressing Grandpa, _Melissa_ filled with graphic nudity, and _Darkstalker_ featuring gory violence and domestic abuse. But here’s what’s really alarming. We can’t just sit back and say, “Well, I’ll just make sure my family doesn’t go to “Drag Queen Story Hour” and we won’t check out those inappropriate books.” That may be good for your family – for now. But meanwhile, the ALA uses our taxpayer-funded libraries to lure in millions of other children who grow up to be the very activists who are destroying our country and conservative values! **[**I hope you see why I need your help today to TAKE BACK OUR LIBRARIES.**](http://email.email.freethinkerdaily.com/c/eJw8j02PmzAQhn_NcDOyxwaHA4dNCVW12kvazaEX5I_xxloICMym_PuKNOplDo_eeWceM0x9DFsN-giI1-gXQAT5Aohrkhfz_v42b-xP9ZvdJdKOAb8BYtom-p98luQ0mNjvVDeZrxUaEVxGtdBYcoGlLrNrXRwKywshnT1UxHVwxtigtEQvtDdKZrFGjopXgqMsdCFybaXQFaEpLepQFqD441AeZqJ0jbdPmr2J_Za7ccj6-prStDweawHbhdw6U25u5Me0JwBbO5svYnYcPxfAVgaFTllkwTvNFFacVQeHzEpXOGU0964C2a5p6JZxnR2BbNj5dAEsdzaQj-sAsjm9PYkzw2Tixw1k80-Fl92x-d4dj93rj_MrdufTpfv56-XM9vFcSjTvJSF5kc21n-6x7-NSalD842G7y33V-DcAAP__aa2CTA)** My name is Kirk Cameron. Maybe you recognize me from the 1980’s family sitcom “Growing Pains” or from my work in inspirational movies like “Fireproof” and “Left Behind.” I know firsthand how dangerous it is to be indoctrinated by leftist values. Pride almost took me down as a young actor in Hollywood. But the gospel saved me. I love being an actor, but what’s far more important is being a husband, dad, grandad, and a Christian. When I saw what book publishers and libraries were doing to indoctrinate children with anti-God, anti-family, anti-America messages, I knew I had a duty to take action. So together with a small Christian book publisher aptly named **Brave Books** , I wrote “As You Grow” to teach children how to grow in wisdom through the fruit of the spirit. And then we decided to go one step further and counter those awful “Drag Queen Story Hours” with a wholesome Story Hour of our own. Our idea was to read the classic books you and I grew up with plus new wholesome Brave Books that captivate children with lessons in bravery, honesty, kindness, and patriotism. And boy, the ALA and radical librarians didn’t like that one bit. >> Over 50 libraries rejected our request to host our Story Hour. >> The ALA helped local libraries scheme ways to keep us out including booking all the event rooms for themselves. >> Social media blew up with attacks: I was compared to a Nazi (that’s original), Brave Books was accused of trying to “confuse and demoralize children,” our supporters were described as “bored moms/busybodies who need something to feel good about,” and on and on. I can’t even print most things these radicals said because it’s so vile. In the end we got two libraries to reverse course by reminding them that their censorship violated the Constitution of the United States. And thousands of parents and grandparents brought their little ones to those Story Hours where we pledged allegiance to the flag, sang “God Bless America,” and read wholesome and Godly books. It was incredible. But here’s the greatest part... From there, parents and grandparents started asking Brave Books how they could host Story Hours of their own. So Brave Books has organized a nationwide grassroots “See You at the Library” movement to take back our libraries. Now with the guidance of Brave Books, committed conservatives just like you book event rooms at their local library for conservative Story Hours that fill children’s hearts with goodness, gratitude, and God. And whenever we can, Brave Books authors like swimmer Riley Gaines, TV personality Missy Robertson, and myself stand shoulder-to-shoulder with conservative parents, grandparents, and patriots at these Story Hours... ...for a very simple mission – to reject the Left’s radical ideas and reclaim childhood innocence in America’s libraries. And our ambitious goal is to expand our “See You at the Library” movement to reach over 100,000 children in the next year. Which is why we need you! __**[_I hope you’ll be able to give a sponsorship gift of $35, $50, $75, $100, $150 or more today._..](http://email.email.freethinkerdaily.com/c/eJw8j02PmzAQhn_NcDOyxwaHA4dNCVW12kvazaEX5I_xxloICMym_PuKNOplDo_eeWceM0x9DFsN-giI1-gXQAT5Aohrkhfz_v42b-xP9ZvdJdKOAb8BYtom-p98luQ0mNjvVDeZrxUaEVxGtdBYcoGlLrNrXRwKywshnT1UxHVwxtigtEQvtDdKZrFGjopXgqMsdCFybaXQFaEpLepQFqD441AeZqJ0jbdPmr2J_Za7ccj6-prStDweawHbhdw6U25u5Me0JwBbO5svYnYcPxfAVgaFTllkwTvNFFacVQeHzEpXOGU0964C2a5p6JZxnR2BbNj5dAEsdzaQj-sAsjm9PYkzw2Tixw1k80-Fl92x-d4dj93rj_MrdufTpfv56-XM9vFcSjTvJSF5kc21n-6x7-NSalD842G7y33V-DcAAP__aa2CTA)** Your sponsorship gift will be used to send a “Story Hour Kit” to every parent, grandparent, and patriot who’s organizing an event at their library. The kit includes everything they need to bring your conservative values back into our public libraries: instructions for booking their library space and running their Story Hour, small American flags for the little ones, fun stickers, wholesome books, Bible memory verse cards, and other specialty items. Brave Books is a small Christian company. They don’t have the millions behind them like the giant taxpayer-funded ALA.
